tei:div.tei:p: /sku zab lam gsang ba snying khrag lasaḥ gsol 'debs bar chad lam sel bsdus pa byin rlabs 'byung gnas bzhugs so ༷na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye shānaskya/shākashā /rwa dad mos gdung shugasadrag po yis gu ru yad la dran byas nas dus rgyun gsol 'debs 'ad nyid bskyar bar chad zhi nges gtan tshig yinaḥ sa ma yāḥ e ma hoX sku gsum ston pa snang ba mtha' yas kyiX thugs sprul 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byungaX khyad 'phags rig 'dzin sku la gsol ba 'debasaX phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang ༷ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobasaX dur khrod brgyad gshegs brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzadaḥ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i 'gro ba smin grol byasaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me rab tu sbar gu ru mtshan mchog brgyad la gsol ba 'debs phyi nang gsang ba' bar chad zhi ba dang ༷ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobasaX nyon mongs gdung ba tsha zer drag po yisaḥ mnar ba'i dmus long 'gro khams kha lo bsgyuraḥ bcom ldan gu ru drug la gsol ba 'debasaX phyi nang gsang

ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang ཿ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs spre'u tsha rgyud gnag blo rmongs gtum pa rnamasaX thugs rje'i thabs kyis dam chos lam la bkodaḥmakhan slob chos gsum sku la gsol ba 'debs phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang0 bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobasaḥ mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag bzhengasaḥ mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me gsal bar byas rje 'bangs rigs 'dzin tshogs la gsol ba 'debasaX phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang ༷ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs sku tshab lung bstan gsung tshab gter du mas thugs kyi dgongs pa las can bu la bzhag gu ru thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang ཿ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i rgud pa bsal ba dngaX sgrub mchog bsam pa yid bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i lhag pa'i lha mchog nyid la gsol ba 'debs phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang ༷ bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobasaḥ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus la bab

pa'i tshe0 rang snang dag pa dpal ri pad+ma'i zhing ston 'khor rnams par dag pa rab mched nasaX 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du skye bar shogaḥ 67 atu badz+ra gun pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ de ltar gsol ba btab pa yis phya nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel nyams dang rtogs pa' yon tan 'phel dbang dang dngos grub thob par 'gyur bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal the tshom med do sa ma māḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyiḥ ces pa 'di'ang btsun chung kirta' skye rtags can de yis bskul ngorabadag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab te yi ge pa ni pad+ma smon sems kyi bgyi pa'o

badz+ra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ sngon 'gro rnam mkhyen lam bzang gi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥbadz+ra them med3niḥ na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra yeḥ byu/rnamaca)thajam dad dang mas gus gdung ba drag po yis thal sbyar snyan pa' dbyangs kyis 'di skad doḥ e ma hoḥ gdod nas ye sangs rgyas pa kun tu bzang: lhun grub 'gags med rigs lnga gangs chen mtshoḥ thugs rje rmad byung bcom ldan rdo rje semaḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod chos kyi 'byung nas dga' rab rdo rje dang rdzogs chen ston pa rig 'dzin shrī seng0 mkhas shing grub pa mañju mi tra laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brtes pad+ma 'byungaḥ bi ma mi tra ye shes bka' rgya mtshoḥ zag phung 'od skur grol ba mtsho rgyal laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod blo gros dbang phyug khye'u chung ye shes dbyingasaX don gnyis mthar phyin rje 'bangs nyi shu lngaḥ brtul zhugs mthar phyin bdud 'dul rdo rje laX gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod

don gyi rig 'dzin dpa' bo rol pa rtsal chos nyid klong rdol rdo rje khro bo lod snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod skye med dbyingasalasadagongs pa ma g.yos kyangaḥ thugs rje'i rang gzugs rdo rje'i bla ma yisaX rjes bzungs dbang bskur blo sna chos la bsgyur phyi nang rkyen zhi sa lam mthar phyinanas: kun du bzang po'i rgyal sa zin par regagaḥ de ltar gsol btab phyi nang bdud las rgyal nyams rtogs yon tan yar nga'i zla ltar 'phel dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su rnam par 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rjepad+ma'i bka' shin tu zab pa las kyang ches zab pa rmad byung rdo rje snying po' chos sde rnams grub pa' dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtadaḥ da lta ma spel rin chen brda la thobs mdo khams rtse shod gshams du dgongs rgya mdzod ma'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga spru'adadaba' bo nus ldan rdo rje da ཿ 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal dkon mod rgyal khams 'grims la lto sa dang mthong bka' gsang thub par srungs shag nges nus ma skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgyaḥ las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par sgo gaḥ sa ma wāḥ rgya rgya rgya brgyud 'debs byin rlabs bcud chen

bsgo/: rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgyaḥ sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgyaḥ yo rgyan gyi slon dpon pad+ma sa wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'oḥ brda zim dziḥ zhes pa 'di ya rdo rje'i lung gi bsngags pa 'a skyes mchog pad+ma nor bus rdzas sna tshogasadang bcas nas yang yang bskul ba dang / chos bdag chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang slob bu ye shes rat+na sa ra rnams cis nan du bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra dpa' bo nu ldan rdo rjes 'bros phug ḍazhi'i 'du gling nas rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin rlabs mdzad pa'i gnas nas pad+ma'i gsang brda zab mo las zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba ma ye

badz+ra chos nyid dgongs pa'i klong mdzod lasaḥ sku 'phreng gsol 'debs byin rlabs gnad 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥbadz+ra na mo gu ru weḥ e ma hoḥ skye med chos sku'i ston pa kun du bzangaḥ ma 'gags rang grol longs sku snang mtha' yasaḥ thugs rje rmad byung rnal 'byor nus ldan paraḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod thub pa'i spyan sngar 'phags pa shā ri'i buX o rgyan yul spyod chos rgyal trig na paX nor bu go leb yang dag mngon gyur dpalaḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaX bod khams mun sel pad+ma'i spyan snga rtsa 'brog mi lo tsā khye'u chung ye shes blo bstan pa'i phyi mo nor bu don 'grub la gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ dgongs pa mi 'gyur rnal 'byor mkhar nag paḥ sbyor sgrol thabs mkhas mgon po rdo rje dang ༷ chos kyi mdzod 'dzin he pa chosa'abyung la gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod zab gter mnga' bdag bdud 'dul rdo rje dang : grub brtes dbang phyug dpa' bo rol pa stsalaX chos nyid klong

rdol rdo rje khro lod laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ mkha' spyod gnas nyul ye shes rdo rje dang ༷ zab gsang sgo 'byed rdo rje drag po rtsalaX brtul zhugs mthu stobs nus ldan rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaḥ ma 'ongs bstan pa'i nyam kun skyong gling gcod spyon drag bshad rol pa'i rdo rje dang ཿ o rgyan bdechen gling pa ye shes mdzodaḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaX gdug pa tshar gcod rdo rje bsam 'grub rtsal 'khrul zhig rnal 'byer o rgyan zhig po baḥthabs mkhas spyod pa bskyang ba'i mkha' khyab rjeḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzodaX snyigs ma'i 'gro mgon o rgyan las 'phro glingaḥ byams pa'i spyan sngar byang sems ral gri 'dzinaḥ ma 'ongs sangs rgyas mos pa mthas yas gragasaX gsol ba 'deb so bdag rgyud smin 11la mdzodaḥ de ltar sku yi phreng ba bsam mtha' yas ༷ yid la dran cing rtse gcig gsol btab mthusaḥ khregs chod chos sku'i dgongs klong mngon gyur nasaḥ gang shar sku dang ye shes rol par mthongaḥ thod rgal snang bzhi'i nyams len mthar

badz+ra 'byel te ༷zad pa gsum rdzogs gzhon nu bum sku'i sbubs 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen por sangs rgyas shogaḥde ltar mos pas gsol btab byin rlabs 'jug phyi nang gegs zhi bsam pa lhun gyi grubaḥs ma yuḥrgya rgya rgyaḥces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang ཿdad ldan las rab zhesabyas dar dang shog gu bcas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa 'a bo nu ldan rdo rjesa'abros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag par pha ba pa dge legs 'phelaḥsarba ma le/

/khu drag sngags me 'dus spu gri'i 'khor lo lasaḥ khro bo rdo rje gtsug tor can gyi gsol 'debs bdud las rnam rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ/sku na mo gu ru shrī kro ta rā dza ya so〉〈〈gatho sa khyed shes dad pa drag po yaḥgasol ba gdab pas rim pa niḥ e ma hoX kun du bzang po che mchog he ru gaX rig rnga yab yum sems dpa' lcam dral laX gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud byin rlabs stsolaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig sgo gsum smin grol mdzodaX mkhyen brtse nus mthus gter chen rig gsum mgon rgyal kun ye shes rdo rje pad 'byung laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud byin rlabs stsolaḥ byin gyis rlobs shig sgo gsum smin grol mdzod0 mi brjed gzungs thob ye shes mtsho rgyal ma dbang gi bka' bab rgyal ba mchog dbyangs laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud byin rlabs stsolaX byin gyis rlobs shig sgo gsum sminagrol mdzodaḥ las can rje 'bangs snyang gi bu dgu dang ཿ rgyal tshab sprul pa'i gter ston brgya rtsa laḥ gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud byin rlabs stsolaX byin gyis rlobs shig

sgo gsum smin grol mdzodaḥ chos rgyal rig 'dzan bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsalaXrtsa rgyud bla ma bka' drin can rnams laX gsol ba 'debs so dgongs brgyud byin rlabasastsol byin gyis rlobs shig sgo gsum smin grol mdzodaḥlhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gtsug tor rgyalaXrgyan gyi lha gsum go cha lha lnga laḥgasol ba 'debs so bdud dpunga'ajoms pa dang ཿbyin gyis rlobs shig nus mthu stobs rdzogs shogaḥgatsug tor lha mo bcom ldan gdugs dkar rgyalaḥphyir bzlog ngan sngags rigs sngags grub pa mor gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms pa dang ཿbyin gyis rlobs shig nus mthu stobs rdzogs shogaḥzhi mdzad dung mchu rgyas byed gser gyi mchuḥdabang brgyur zangs mchudrag po lcags kyi mchuX gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms pa dang ཿbyin gyis rlobs shig nus mthu stobs rdzogs shog phyogasabacu'i gdon 'dul phyogs skyong bsnolaba'i kharaḥbadud 'dul khro bcu yab yum za gsod laḥgasol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms pa dang ༷ byin gyis rlobs shig nus mthu stobs rdzogs shog phyogs bzhi'i

/khu rkyen bzlog phrin las bzhi bsgrub paḥ ye shes sgo bzhi skyong mdzad pho nya laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bdud dpung 'joms pa dang ཿ byin gyis rlobs shig nus mthu stobs rdzogs shogaḥ de ltar khyed shes dad pas gsol btab mthusaḥ lus ngag yid kyi 'dzin zhen rang sar dgaḥ gdos por blta ba'i snang zhen dri ma grolaḥ khu rdul rlung sems sgyu lus rab smin teḥ he ru ka dpal rdo rje gtsug tor klongaX grong 'pho grong 'jug dngas ma'i sku mchog brtesaX rmad byung mdzad pas 'gro khams dong sprugs shog de ltaragasol btab byin rlabs 'jug dngos grub nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel sa ma māḥs ma slob dpon khrag thug nag po yi drag bsgrub man ngag rgya mtsho las gtad bzlog gtad sel gtad bkrol skor snyigs dusargud paskyobs pa'i phyir rin chen brda yis sgrom du bcug mdo khams gnyan po g.yu rtser sbas rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshe skal ldan las can gcig gis rnyed gdul bya'i lhag ma de yis skyobs 'gro don byang nas byang rong rgyas 'brel tshad rigs 'dzin zhang du 'god bka' 'di tsho mo dung skyongs dang dregs pa sde bdun dag la gnyer 'dod sred can la mi 'chor bar thugs sras rag 'dzan dpal du sprodaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thimaḥlhaḥ zhesapa

'di'ang lung zin grags pa'i dpal gyis bskul ba dang ཿ tshogs smon las kyi 'phro 'dzoms pad+ma dpon g.yog nasanan tan chen pos bskul ngoraḥ 7 kho bo bdud 'jom khyung drag rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni bskul ba po nyid kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba maṅga le/

/sku skad cig dran rdzogasagasal 'debs niḥ ā: rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid bde chen ye shes he ru gaḥ khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor can: ma bskyed rig pas 'khrul rtogs bcoms: badz+ra kro ta 0ston ṣa ma ma hūṃ ni swāhā ye rdzogs rig pas 'khrul rtog sangasaḥ byad ma 'bum bzlog nus mthu sgemaḥ sa ma yuḥ 'da'ang nus ldan dpa' bos so bstod pa niḥ tsū e nyid stong pa bde ba'i gzugs khro rgyal bdud bgegs nyon mongs gshed: rdo rje gtsug tor 'bar ba'i garaḥ gdul dka' 'dul la phyag 'tshal stodaḥ 'ad yang nus ldan dpa 'a bo sa so sham niḥbyad phur gtad mnan khrol khrol phyung phyung swā lha zhes sbyar ro skyabs yul bskyed pa ni mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus suḥ bdud bzhi nyi zla pad+ma'i kharaḥ rgyal ba thams cad kyi gtsug tor ye shes kyi 'khor lo nas sprul pa'i khro rgyal badz+rayas ye shes lnga'i rang 'od 'bar ba'i dbu stong ngoms shing ༷ ma rig 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo bde chen gyi dbyings su kha lo bsgyur ba'i phyag stong gis mtshon cha sna tshogs gdeng ba 'bar ba'i sku la dur khrod dpal chas kyis brgyan zhing zhabs rnams bsgrad pa'i bdud

bzhi 'jigs brgyad mi ma yin ro lang 'byung po'i tshogs phyi chings su 'gyel ba'i khar brdzis paX dbu la bde gshegs gdung bdun gyis brgyan zhing phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyasasras dang bcas pa'i gzi byin 'bar ba legs ldan nag po mched gsum dang lha klu drang sgong rig pa 'dzin pas bstod bsngags brjod bzhin par bzhugs nasaX rang cag dadaldan rnams la zhal gyis phyogs spyan gyis gzigasaX thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs shing srungs skyobs mdzad par mos laX skyabs 'gro skyabs sems tshogs bsags rgyas par bya lanabadun/ dzahūṃza hoX tshogs zhing rnams rang la bsdus te gnyis su med par gyur nas gdug pa can 'dul zhing dkar phyogs skyong ba las la 'chun pa'i mthu ldan du gyur parabasam 31: 'di yang sgrub pa' cha lag ṣānus ldan dpal gyi rdo rje yas mkha' 'gro gsang ba' brda las brgyur yi ge'i mthun skyen sī tris mdzad dge bas gdul zhi smin grol shog sarba ma le/

/sku drag sngags me 'dus spu gri'i 'khor lo lasaḥ khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor can gyi byin 'bebs 'od kyis drwa ba bzhugasaX /sku na mo gu ru shrī kro ta ra dza yaX spesha6)mi rnal yor rtogs pa yo phyu ju la sha za dud bta rol mo dkrol snyan pa'i glu yi rta la dra pas rtsa gsum gzi byin 'bebs pa ni hūṃ hūṃ dzaḥ'og min chos dbyingasadabus mtha' med pa nas dgongs brda' snyan brgyud bla mas byin phob cig: dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas: khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor byin phob cig bde stong 'dus ma byas pa'i pho brang nas: dag pa dbyings gsum mkha' 'gro'i byin phob cig phyogs bcu'i gdon 'dul phyogs skyongs zil gnon pa'iḥ ye shes khro bo'i tshogs kyi byin phob cigaX sa gsum byad gtad 'khrul 'khor bcom mdzad pa'iḥ 'bar ba'i khyung chen sde bzhi'i byin phob cigaX tshad med 1nga nas phrin las glog ltar 'gyu pho nya sgo ba bzhi yis byin phob cigaḥ bcu drug dga' ba stong ba'i dpal 'byed pa'iḥ gnas yul dpa' bo dpa' mos byin phob cigaḥ spyi bor bde chen 'khor lo'i

rgyan gcig puḥ bka' drin mtshungs med bla mas byin phob cigaḥ gnas dang da la yo byad sgrub rdzas kun zhing dang lha sngags bdud rtsi'i byin phob cigaḥ ye nas rang chas dag pa rab 'byams klong snang zhen dri bral dag smin rdzogs byin phobaḥ rang nyid lha la lha nyid rang thim steḥ ye shes gcig rdzogs rtogs pa mngon gyur mdzodaḥ o dz+nya na dhartu badz+ra a we sha ya a āḥ de ltar byin dbab gzi byin bskyed rno la ngar btags ci bzhin noḥ sam yu rgya rgya rgya 'ad yang snying nor shī tri'i ngor nu ldan rolapa' rdo rjes soḥ sarba ma la/

/khu drag sngags me 'dus spu gri'i 'khor lo lasaḥ khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor can gyi gnad bskul gzi byin 'bebs pa bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs bzhugs soḥ /kye na mo gu ru shi kro ta rā dza yaḥ nan/ rkatsan rnal 'byer pa rnams brtul zhugs bskyed sngags kyis lta dgongs ldan pa yisaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ bzhengs shig gshegs shig 'og min gnas nas byonaX bskyod cig bskul lo khro bo rol pa'i dpal ma g.yel ma 'phang sgrub pa'i drod rtags ston gangs dkar rtse nas dpa' bo pho tshogs kyisaḥnyams dga' dwa sa spro rtogs pa'i sgron me sboraḥ rgya mtsho'i gting nas dpa' mo mo tshogs kyisaX 'bar bas 'dzag pa dga' bzhi'i sbrang char bsnyilaḥ mkha' dbyings klong nas ḍak+ki ma tshogs kyisaḥ 'dus ma byas pa'i rtogs pa rang chas ston sa lam sbyang bgrod ring bor mi ltos paraX cig chod thod rgal sngags kyi nye lam gyiḥ tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin sar bsgod nas0 he ru ka dpal nyid du dbyer med mdzodaḥ 61 sarba ta thā ga tasnga skor sa ma ya phe tho a we sha ya a ā ༷ de ltar gnad bskul thabs zab mo'i sgrub la drod rtags 'byung bar 'gyur
/ sa ldan rol pa'i rdo rjes soḥ sarba maṅga le// niḥ ( hūṃ sno nam mkha' gangs ba'i rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkhab pa'i rdzas yo byad thams cad la thim nas mchog thun mong shā

9 /khu drags sngags me 'dus skru gri'i 'khor lo lasaḥ rdo rje gtsug tor can gyis byin 'beb 'od kyi phung po bzhugs soḥspo na mo gu ru shrī kro dha ra dza yaX ༅/tsha/rgalkojus sha go dud bto rol mo lol snyan pa'i glu yos 'ad skad doḥ hū hū dzaḥ mi mngon chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba nasaḥ dgongs brda' snyan brgyud bla ma thugs rje canaX ye shes gzigs pa'i zhal bzang 'dir ngoms laX lhan skyes ga ga ma rtogs pa'i dbang byin phob 'og min du khrod me ri 'bar ba nasaX mdo rgyu sems phyogs yi dam rgya mtsho'i tshogasaX 'bar ba'i khro gar zhi ba'i rnam 'gyur bcasaḥ chos dbyings rig pa'i gter mthong dbang byin phobaX mkha' spyod o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas rdo rje rnal 'byor 'dzum pa'i dpa' stong 'byud gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yis bde stong ye shes rtogs pa'i dbang byin phob phrin las lhun grub bka' yi tha ram nas rdo rje'i sgog ldan dam can sde bdun dang ཿ phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang srung ma yis0 phrin las mi nub dpal 'bar dbang byin

/sku ston mtha' yas pa'iX bka' rgyud rig 'dzin bla mas thugs dam bskangs dam tshigs nyams chags nyes tshogs zhi ba dang ཿ tshe bsod nyams rtogs yonatan 'phel rgyas shing rlung sems mos bzhi dbang du 'du ba dang ཿ log rtogs ru tra bdud bzhi 'dul ba dang ཿ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cigaḥ hū hrī dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings nyid las mthu rtsal thogs med che btsan dbang phyug pa khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor can rig sngags dmod pa tshar gcodathugs dam bskangasaḥ dbus zhal nyis brgya mthing nag gtum pas nyams g.yas zhal nyis brgya ser nag 'dzum pa'i 'khyud rgyab zhal nyis brgya dmar nag chags sgegasa'abar log 'dren bdud dpung 'joms mdzad thugs dam bskags g.yon zhal nyis brgya ljang nag khros shing 'khrugs steng zhal nyis brgya dkar gsal bshad nyams ldan dmar zlum spyan stong sdang mig glong ltar 'khyugs khro rgyal he ru ka dpal thugs dam bskangs phyag g.yas stong phrag 'phrul gcod ral gri bsnams g.yon pa stong phrag mtshon

mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs ro mnyam kun du snyoms pas dkyil 'khor nasaḥ tshad med byams pas gdul bya mi gtong 'dzinaX kun kyang dpal ldan bkod par dbugasadabyung ba'i: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ bde chen chags bral sor rtogs ye shes sku dga' bas sgrog gis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyobs:tshogs smon las 'dzoms pad+ma brtsegs par bkod: gsung mchog rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ dag grol rol pa chen po'i dkyir 'khor nas: gtang snyoms dril bu'i 'gro khams rmongs mun selaḥ gdul bya las rab bkod rdzogs zhing du 'godaX garmā rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs dbyings la gnas shing legs nyes stangs sgog 'dzinaḥ gsang ba'i snyib po gsang sngags bstan la gdungaḥ kha na ma tho grub mtha' dman la gshe: dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma tshogs thugs dam bskangs: 'jigs rten khams su 'byu bas dpal 'dzin cingaḥ nad mug mtshon 'khrugs dus kyis rgud pa sel: legs tshogs dpal da yon tan skyed mdzad pa'i 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma tshogs

/khu thugs dam bskangs rlung sems dbang bsgyur skye 'gro'i sgog la gnas sngags kyi dbang phyug zhabs pad spyi bor lenaX log rtogs 'khrul snang khyo yis sha la zaḥ sha za mkha' 'gro ma tshogs thugs dam bskangasaḥ hūṃ hrīḥthugs dam gnyen po bskangs ba'i dam rdzas niḥ lha rdzas phyi mchod rang byung nang mchod dang ཿ gsang mchod bde chen sbyin pa'i rigs ma'i tshogasaḥ dug gsum gnas stong sman raka gtor chen poḥ khams gsum 'khor ba ka dag ro mnyam tshogasaḥ kun du bzang po'i dga' ston mtha' yas pas ༷ yi dam rdo rje gtsug tor thugs dam bskangasaḥ dam tshigs nyams chags nyes tshogs zhi ba dang ཿ tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel rgyas shingaḥ rlung sems mos bzhi dbang du 'du ba dang ཿ log rtogs ru tra bdud bzhi 'dul ba dang 0 bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cigaḥ / jeḥ bsil ba tshal gyis dur khrod chen po dang gnam lcags ma la ya yi rtse mo ru rā tra'i dpung 'joms gsang sngags bstan srung ba: dpal mgon ma ning 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs skye med dbyings las ye shes sgyu

'phrul gar: 'bum phrag rgyud kyis drod 'dzin tha tshig can: log rtog zhing bcu'i don snying skog mar 'byin: sgrug nag e ka dza ṭi'i thugs dam bskangs phyogs rnams ma ngesadur khrod kun du rgyu dkar mo rgya bong rlung gi gshogs ldan bcibs: khams gsum yid kyis bskor ba'i bya ma rta: lha mo dpal 'bar chen mo'i thugs dam bskangs las su sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen srungs: zas su dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag za: gos su mi lpags g.yang gzhi sku la klubs: shan pa sgog sgrub nag mo'i thugs dam bskangs king ko chen po brgyad la rnam par rgyu: nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhir mnga' dbang mdzad: nyams pas sgog dbugs len pas mthu rtsal can: drang sgong gza' bdud rgyal po'i thugs dam bskangs0 rgyal ba shāka thub bstan pa mchog la gus: gsang bas dbang rtags rdo rje dgra snying 'dzin: bya seng ra skyes zhen pa drug cu'i 'khor: dpung ldan skyes mchog rdor legs thugs dam bskangasaḥ he chen dha na'i dur khrod zhing skyong ba gnod sbyin dmar nag me yi phung po can ā ti rin chen bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin pa mi srun shan pa

dmar nag thugs dam bskangasaḥ dus gsum rgyal kun phrin las gnyer 'dzin cingaX nus mthu thogs med mtshon rnon dgra la 'debs dam ldan bsrungs sma nyams ru tra'i gshed bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ hūṃ hrīX thugs dam gnyan po bskangs ba'i dam rdzas ni lha rdzas phyi mchod rang byung nang mchod gsang mchod bde chen sbyin pa'i rigs ma'i tshogasaX dug gsum gnas stong sman raka gtor chen po khams gsum 'khor ba ka dag ro mnyam tshogasaḥ kun du bzang po'i ston mtha' yas pasaḥ yi dam rdo rje gtsug tor thugs dam bskangasaX dam tshigs nyams chags nyes tshogs zhi ba dang ཿ tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel rgyas shing ༷mas mos bzhi dbang du 'du ba dang ཿ log rtogs ru tra bdud bzhi 'dul ba dang ཿ bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cigaX de ltar bskangs zhing bshags pa na hū badz+ra a k+to bh+ya: rdo rje rigs kyi thugs dam las zhe sdang dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags lho nas rat+na saṃ bha tre: rin chen rigs kyi

thugs dam las nga rgyal dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: nub nas pad+ma dhe wa hrī pad+ma rigs kyi thugs dam lasaḥ 'dod chags dam tshig nyams so 'tshal: 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags: byang nas a mo gha sirnyi: las kyi rigs kyis thugs dam lasaḥ phrag dog dam tshig nyams so 'tshal 'di yang mi mthol lo bshags: dbus na badz+ra sa tā hūṃ: de bzhin rigs kyi thugs dam las gti mug dam tshig nyams so 'tshal 'di yang mi 'chab mthol lo bshags de ltar bska sa bshags byas pa yis rnal 'byor gsang sngags sgor zhugs nas rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig la 'gal 'das zhig ral skyon byung ba thams cad sor chud dag tshangs 'gyuraḥ sa ma wāḥ i ma glob dpon khrag 'thunganag po ya drag bsgrub man ngag rgya mtsho las gtad bzlog gtad sel gtad bkrol skor snying dus gdul bya skyobs pa'i ched rin chen brda yis sgrom du bcug mdo khams gnyan po g.yu rtser sbas sngon po'i mtsho la phyag rgyas bsdams rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshe rgyal tshab lasacan gcig gis rted snyigs 'gro'i rgud pa de yisaskyobs nad mug mtshon cha'i gzengs pa zhi 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'god bka' 'di klu mo dung skyong dang dregs

je — pa bdun gyis thub par srungs 'dod sred can la ma 'chor bar thugs sras rig 'dzin phyag tu sprod sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya brda thim lha zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin grags pa'i dpal gyis bskul ba dngatshogs smon las 'dzoms shad lha gong ma pad+ma nas bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ 7kho bo bdud 'dul bzhi pa khyung drag rol pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'iyi ge pa ni btsun pa pad+mas bgyas pa dge legs 'phe la/ sarba maṅga lo/

ze drags sngags me 'dus sbu gri'i 'khor lo lasaḥ khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor can gyis dgyes bskang gnam phud yid bzhin char 'bebs bzhugs so:/sku na mo gu ru kro dha ra dza yaḥ ཿ dngos 'gror yid sprul mchod tshogs 'bul gnam phud bskang ba 'di ltar bya bh+yoḥ 'og min gnas dang o rgyan mkha' spyod yulaḥ nyer bzhi so gnyis dur khrod he ru'i zhing bde ba mchog gi dpal ston la rol rnams: nye 'du tshogs kyi ro la da tshur gshegs rin chen pad zla mdzes pa'i gdan la bzhugasaX rang gsal rtogs pa 'char phyir brda phyag 'tshalaḥ thabs mchog dpa' bo'i ro yis thugs dam bskangasaX shes rab dpa' mo'i 'dzum gyis thugs dam bskangs: bde stong 'bar ba'i 'dzag pas thugs dam bskangs: gnyis med spangs blang bral bas thugs dam bskangs: nyams bskang ga ṇa tsakras thugs dam bskangs: dga' bzhi'i dpal sbyin rig mas thugs dam bskangs: ye shes rol pa'i bro yis thugs dam bskangs: khams gsum yongs grol gar gyis thugs dam bskangs: mtshan ma tshig bral smra yis thugs dam bskangs:

'khor gsum yongs dag dgongs pa'i thugs dam bskangs rnam mang phrin las char rgyun mi nub paraX phywa dang g.yang gi dga' ston dpal nor spel chos kyi gzhi tshug bshad sgrubs bstan pa daraḥ gdug pa'i dpa' rkong dge ba'i dpal bskyed cing rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gdung 'tshob skal ldan nas 'ja' lus 'od skur bsgrod pa'i phrin las mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ de ltar bskang bas bsam don 'grub phyi nang bar chad bdud las rgyal don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za bka' 'di o rgyan spul pa dang ཿ 'phrad nas bstan 'gror sman gyur cig sam wāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye brda zim snyiḥ zhesapa 'da'ang lung zin grags pa' dpal rgyas bskul ba da / tshogs smon lasa'adzom pad+ma dpon g.yog nas bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo bdud 'dul bzhi pa khyung drag rol pa rtsal gyasadabyingasasnang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las brgyur ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

rmi tshogs la rol ba ni kyeḥ gzigs shig rdo rje slob dpon rgyalaX 'di ni mtshan ma dag pa'i rdzas blangs dor yid chos bral ba rtsa de bzhin nyid du dgong rolaX zhes slob bus gus 'dud kyis nyams dang ldan pas 'bul e ma lha ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos sangs rgyas kun gyis bzhes lhag 'di ༷ dngos grub ya mtshan che ba'i skyesaX bzhin nyid rol bdag phyag 'tshalaḥ a la la ho ༷ zhesardo rje slob dpon gyis pad+mas phyag rgyas blangs te rol bar bya'o ho: bde bar bshagags chen bcom ldan 'das: rig lnga yab yum ma‘ sbyor skyems myang bas ngan song skye sgo khegasaḥ yid ches rig 'dzin zhabs drung 'godaḥ 'di la the tshom tsam yang med ngo mtshar dad bcas bdag phyag 'tshalaḥ a ho ma hā sdoṭ+wāṃhūṃ sa /rdo ṭ+wāṃ/ ༵la 'byor pho mo kun gyis rol khyi dang dman sprang la mi spyin dngos grub rang gas longs spyod na yon tan thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ 'di yang zhang po pad+ma'i ngor nus ldan rol ba
ṭ+wāṃ drag sngags me 'dus spu gri'i 'khor lo lasaḥ byad ma 'bum bzlog khro chu dug rdzongs bzhugs soḥ

/kye na mo gu ru kro ta rā dza yaḥ chen2)sache/sko1ke 'jigs byed 'jigs pa'i mthu mnga' ba khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor can bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan tu mchod byang chub sgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe bzlog 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na mo ba nga grol med pa'i gnyug ma sku gsum laḥ 'phral snang rgud pa bsal phyir skyabs su mchiḥ log rtog byad mas bcing mnan bkrol ba'i phyiraX khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor bsgom par byaḥ lan gsum rjes su daro sa gzhi lha bskyed niḥ eḥ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan chos kyi dbyings bde chen rang gsal kun snang byang chub semasaḥ ma brtsal rig pa rgyu yi sa bon niḥ 'khor 'das kun gyi srog gi dwangs mar gnasaḥ badz+ra sa ma dhi (ཿ e nyid stong pa dbyings phyug yum gyi mkharaḥ bde stong khod snyoms 'byung ba bzhi rim klong dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung dug mtsho 'byel sra brtan rdo rje'i brag steng bdud bzhi dang ཿ 'jigs brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs rnams bsgol ba'i khar rig pa hūṃ yig spro bsdus zhu ba las khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor can stong phrag dbu la khro tshul du mas 'byud: nyes stong phyag gis bzlog

/sku bsgyur mtshon cha gdengaX zhabs rnams bsgrad pas skye bzhi'i kha lo bsgyur dur khrod dpal chas dpa' ba'i rtags su klubasaḥ ha ha hūṃ phaṭa gad rgyang 'brugaltar sgrogasaX nyi zla'i spyan 'khyil sdang mig glog ltar 'khyugasaX ba spu'i me rlung dug mtshon khro rdul 'khrigasaḥ rdo rje gdung bdun dbu gtsug ral gseb brgyanaḥ dngul gserazangs lcags rdo rje'i mchu can bzhisaḥ sa 'og gtad mnan byad phur rbod gtong 'jomasaḥ rdo rje 'bebs mdzad khro bo chen po bcus ma rungs gdon dang 'jigs pa'i tshogasakun 'tharaḥ bka' nyan pho nya sde bzhis brin las sgrubasaḥ legs ldan mched gsum sgrub mchog rnal 'byor grogs: dpal mgon sangs rgyas bstan srung las la 'duḥphyi rem zangs lcags 'khor lo rtsibs stong ba g.yas g.yon 'khor ba'i spu gri'i so ngar gyisaḥ sha za ro lang 'byung po'i tshogs rnams dang ཿ me chu dug mtshon 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs padang gtad mnan rbod gtong byed pa'i byad ma rnams tshar bcad rdul brlag bsreg gtub stong par byedaX rgyan gyi lha gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i skus lus ngag yid la bde ba

mchog gsang sbyin go cha lha lnga rdo rje srung ba'i rdzong : rgyud lnga dug lnga'i yul sa stong par byedaḥ sgog gis bskul te me ru 'bar ba dang ཿ rab 'jigs rngams brjed dpag yas zhing khams nas: rgyal kun phrin las mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa rdo rje gtsug tor rnam par spyan drangs bstimasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaX dzaḥsnobaṃḥhoḥ sa ma ya na mo hoḥ ma hā byu dza hoḥ hū hrīḥ 'bar ba'i gar ldan rdo rje'i sku mchog gisaḥ sa gsum sde rgyad gdug pa'i dpung tshogs 'daraX dran pas mi mthun phyogs kun stong par bsreX khro bo'i rgyal po gtsug tor can la bstod bsnyen 'dzab gyi 'phrul sabar naḥ hūḥ chos dbyings mi 'gyur e sang nas bzhengs pa'i: khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor gyiḥ thugs sgog (ཿlas spros pa'i 'od zer dang ཿ khro chung phag khyung nyi rdul ltar 'tshubs pasaX ri rab rming bzlog rgya mtsho'i gting dkrugs nas ban bon bsam ngan rbod gtong sbyor ba yis 'byung ba lnga la gtad mnan byas pa sprags rnam shes tshe srog dṛ yi rnam par bsdasaḥ bdag dang bgrang bya yon bdag snying gar bsdimaḥ nyi zwa skar tshogs gza' dang chu 'dzin las grol ba'i dpe

rmi bzhin bkrag mdangs ches cher 'phelaḥnus mthu yon tan stong gis phul phyin dmigs ma badz+ra kro ta rā dza urdzi bdud tri mā ra ya phaṭa swā snyasgrub sngags ni hūḥbadag mdun rdo rje gtsug tor gsal ba yiXsku las me rlung dug mtshon khro tshogs sprosaḥ'abyung bzhis phra rag til gyi gong bur gtams ༷pha rol ban bon kun rgyu'i rig sngags kyisaḥbacings ba'i gto mnan hom zor spar bu bskoraḥthams cad bya sgro me la bsreg bzhin duḥchos dbyings stong pa nyid du zhi zhing bsalaḥlog rtog rgol sbyor byed pa'i byad ma'i dpung tshar bcad rdul brlag nus mthu nyams par dmigasaḥyo sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra35skor sarba mā ra ya dza:mal mal 'gul 'gulaḥtsag tsagaḥgatub gtubaḥkhrol khrolaḥchoms choms bdag dang bsrung bya'i lus ngag yid gsum pha rol bos bcing pa phyes phyes khrol khrol swā snyalas sngags niḥhūṃ hrīḥbadag dang mdun bskyed rdo rje gtsug tor gyiXska las sbos pa'i pho nya khyang gi tshogs nyi jal ltar 'khrigs gshog rlang rlabs g.yos rte srid pa rming bshigs rgya mtsho gting nas dkagasaḥkla gnyan gtod dang sa

bdag la bcol ba'iḥ gtad mnan thams cad rang dbang med par bsdusaX bsrung bya'i ched du he ru ka la phulaḥ dgongs pa'i gzi byin dmigs bya yongs la dbab nadagadon rkyen gegs nyer 'tshe bcing bsdam grolaḥ rnam bzhi'i phrin las thog med sgrub par dmigasaX bla badz+ra kro ta rā dza ār+sha ṣa hrī ha ha hūṃ hūṃ nā ga snyisne ta krita phaṭaḥbla nā ga ye:rdu bha ye: sa stum teḥ ku ru hūṃ dza dza bh+yo bh+yo āḥṣ+ṭṛ shig shig khrol khrol su hā de ltar khro chu dug rdzong sa ga bzlas pa 'bum re tshad 'khyol na byad gtad bcing bsdam nad las grol tshe ring nad med cibasam 'grubaḥs ma māḥgasum pa bskul bzlog ni bdag mdun gyi sku'i cha thams cad nas spros pa'i khro chung dang sprul pa sdigs khyung phag seng gi tshogs thams cad kyis byad ma'i srungaba'i gur phral byad kyi rgya gtoraḥ byad thag dum bur gtubasaX byad kyi e khaṃ bcagaX byad ma'i dmigs gzer phudaḥ byad kyis gtad mnan rang gral du btang nas byad ma khorang la rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i bzlog med du dmigs laX 〉ཿ nga ni spyo dpal he ru gaḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyiX gtsug tor 'od zer las byung ba'i

/khu bzlog bsgyur khro bo stobs po cheḥ badz+ra kro tardzas kha khams gsum srid gsum ngas dbang bsgyuraḥ sprul pa yang sprul bu yug 'tshubs thugs dam chen po'i las la bzhengs byad ma sod la byad thag chod byad rgya khrol la byad gzer phudaḥ byad khang choms la byad phur bzlogaḥ byad ma'i 'khrul 'khor gzhoms shing gzhig kho rang rang gshed rang la dbobasaḥ rdul du brlag pa'i brin las mdzodaḥ hūṃ: 'jig rten khams na g.yo byed pa'i khro rgyal las kyi rdo rje niḥ mdun bskyed rdo rje gtsug tor can che ba'i dbu stong srid rtser mnyamaḥ skye mched mu bzhi 'dar zhing dngangasaḥ g.yas phyag stong gis gzugs khams khyab gnas rigs bcu bdun dam 'og 'duḥ g.yon phyag stong ni 'dod khams brdalaḥ sa gsum dregs tshogs dbang du bsgyur zhabs kyi 'phrul 'khor brtul zhugs kyisaX ngan song gsum po stong par byedaX sprul pa'i khro chung rdul ltar 'phroḥgadug pa'i tshogs rnams thar bar rlogaX yang sprul phag khyung sdigs seng 'gyed ༷ klu gnyan sa bdag gtod dbang bsgyur me rlung dug gi bu yug 'tshubs ban bon kun rgyus

sbyor btab pa bsreg gtub stong pa'i 'khor lor byedaḥ sngon nas thugs bskyed zhal bzhes canaḥ gnad nas bskul lo da bzhengs shig brgyan paligator ma 'di bzhes la byad ma sod la byad thag chod byad rgya khrol la byad gzer phudaḥ byad khang choms la byad phur bzlogaḥ byad ma'i 'khrul 'khor gzhoms shing gzhigaḥ kho rang rang gshed rang ladabobs rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ / phyogs bzhi gnam lcags 'khor lo'i stengaX gdug pa'i gza' klu bsnol ba'i khar khrom las byung b.lirngams 'jigasagazugs ོ bo chen po'i phyag brnyan paḥshar nas dung mchu zla ba'i 'odaḥ rgyal rigs klu gdon zas su byed lho nas gser mchu nyi ma'i zhalaḥ rje rigs klu gdon rngams zasabyed nub nas zangs mchu srin po'i gzugasaḥ bram ze'i klu gnyan hab rol byedaX byang nas lcag mchu gdug cing rtsub gdol ba'i sha dang khrag la rngams gnam sa bar snangakhams la rgyuX mtha' mis rdzas sbyor dug 'gyed gzhom ngan sngags 'bum gyi phur kha thubaX byad dang byur dang ltas ngan bzlogaḥ rigs sngags grub pa'i stobs po cheḥ sngon nas

phyag g.yas gsod gcod mtshon cha yis dpal mgon bdun cu lha yis byad gtad bzlogaḥ stong phrag phyag g.yon brlag byed thun mtshon gyis: sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyis gtad mnan bzlog zhabs rnams bsgrad pas dregs tshogs zil gyis gnon sde dpon sum cu'i gtad mnan 'khrul 'khor bzlog glang chen go rlon stod du klubs pa yisaḥnyon mongs rgyas pa'i gdon gyi 'khrul 'khor bzlog mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i sked chings byas pa yis chags shing zhen pa'i gdon gyi 'phrul 'khor bzlogaḥ stag gi lpags pas smad dkris byas pa yis 'khrugs shing gtum pa'i gdon gyi 'phrul 'khor bzlog thog med stobs kyis gshog pa bsgrad pa yisaX rtsod cing 'thabs pa'i gdon gyi 'phrul 'khor bzlogaX gdol ba nag po sbrul gyis do shal gyis rmongs shing 'thibs pa'i gdon gyi 'phrul 'khor bzlogaX mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal gyisaX kun rtog 'khrul ba'i gdon kyi 'phrul 'khor bzlog ye shes me yi 'od zer 'phro ba yisaX asne rā tsas bsregs mnan 'phrul 'khor bzlogaḥ spu gri reg gcod rlung nag 'tshubs pa yis ba ya

/ be yis spar bu dgra la bzlogaX 'byung po 'bog brgyal dri ngan 'phro ba yisaḥ smon log rwa dza dam sri'i 'thul 'khor bzlog rdo rje gdung bdun dbu labazhugs pa yisaḥ tshogs bdun las byung ma rig 'phrul 'khor bzlogaX bde gshegs bye ba bdun gyis gzigs pa mnga'aḥ khams gsum 'khor ba'i rba klong 'phrul 'khorabazlogaḥ legs ldan nag po mched gsum phrin las sgrubasaḥ lha rnams dbugs 'byin lha min 'phrul 'khor bzlogaX rab 'bar khro chung bu yug ltar 'tshubs pasaḥ mngal dngasha khrag za ba'i gdon rnams bzlogaḥ 'jigs byed skal pa dus mtha'i me lta buX ye shes khro rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ sha khrag brgyan pa'i tshogs gtor 'di bzhes la ban byad bon byad lha klu mi yi byadaḥ sde brgyad lha 'dres mnan cing bsdams pa dang : 'byung ba lnga la gtad mnan byas pa kun mi gnas mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings su bzlog hūṃḥ khro rgyal rngams pa rdo rje gtsug tor gyiḥ sku las byung bas dung mchu dkar po yis rgyal rigs nā ga'i tshogs la rngams zas byedaX shar phyogs sa bdag klu gnyan cho

'phrul bzlogaḥ khro rgyal rngams pa rdo rje gtsug tor gyiḥ yon tan las byung gser mchu ser po yiḥ rje rigs nā ga'i tshogs la longs spyod byed lto phyogs sa bdag klu gnyan cho'aphrul bzlogaḥ 'thar byed khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor gyi gsung las byung bas zangs mchu dmar po yis bram ze'u klu yi tshogs rnams zhal du rol nub phyogs sa bdag kluganyan cho 'phrul bzlog 'jigs byed rngams pa rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phrin las las byung lcags mchu nag po yis gdol ba nag po'i rigs la rngams zas byed byang phyogasas bdag klu gnyan cho 'phrul bzlogaḥ kun kyang kro kri hring hring rngams brjid sgogasaḥ sa 'og gdon gyi tshogs rnams 'bog brgyal byedaX sku las lcags bsregs mtshon cha'i charab 'bebs mi mthun gdug pa'i cho 'phrul la yog bzlogaX 'bar ba'i rā gzeng me rlung thog ser 'phroḥ steng 'og bar gsum bgegs kyis sbyor ba bzlog lcags kyi mchu sder rno ngar rab tu gzengs byad phur rbod gtong gtad mnan 'khrul 'khor bzlogaḥ mjug mar rgyal mo gdong mo las la 'gyed ltas ngan than dang cho 'phrul dgra la bzlog

// g.yas g.yon gshog par khro bo khro mo 'gyedaX mi mthun log spyor g.yo 'khrugs dgra la bzlog bzlog byed khro rgyal khams gsum hūṃ sgra canaḥ ba dan rtse gsum brdab la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i tshogs gtor tshogs ston 'di bzhes la ban byad bon byad lha klu mi yi byadaX sde brgyad lha 'dres mnan cing bsdams pa dang : 'byung ba lnga la gtad mnan byas pa kunaḥ mi gnas mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings su bzlogaḥ hū bye rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog rgyal po yi phrin las pho nya ye shes khro bo'i tshogasaX steng gi phyogs nas khro chen hūṃ ka rasaX lha yi gdon gyis gtad mnan 'phrul 'khor bzlog shar phyogs dbang mdzad rnam par rgyal ba yisaḥ dri za'i gdon gyis gtad mnan 'phrul 'khor bzlogaḥ nub phyogs dbang mdzad rta mgrin rgyal po yis chu lha'i gdon gyi gtad mnan 'phrul 'khor bzlog byang phyogs dbang mdzad bdud rtsi 'byil ba yis0 gnod sbyin gdon gyis gtad mnan 'phrul 'khor bzlog shar lhor dbang mdzad dbyug pa sngon po yisaḥ ban byad bon byad lha klu mi yi byad sde

brgyad lha 'dre'i mnan bcings bsdams pa dang 'byung ba lnga la gtad mnan byas pa kunaX mi gnas mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings su bzlogaḥ aste rā tsas gtad lho nub dbang mdzad mi g.yo mgon po yis rak+ta gdon gyis nub byang dbang mdzad 'dod pa'i rgyal po yis rlung lha'i gdon gyis byang shar dbang mdzad khams gsum rnam rgyal gyis dbang ldan gdon gyis gtad 'og phyog dbang mdzad stobs chen bskul byed masaX sa bdag gdon gyis gtad mnan mi dge gnas dag ye shes khro tshogs kyis: log rtog gdon gyis gtad mnan byas pa kun mngon rlom dge bcu rang grol khro mo'i tshogs mchog 'dzin mngon zhen gdon gyis thabs kyi sprul pa za byed pha bcu yis nyon mongs rgyas pa'i gdon gyi 'phrul 'khor bzlog0 shes rab cha 'dzin khro mo ma bcu yisaX zhen chags a 'thas gdon gyis 'phrul 'khor bzlogaḥ snang srid chos sku thal 'byin dgongs spyod can bdud 'dul brin las dkyil 'khor lha la bstod 'dod yon brgyan gyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes ban byad bon byad lha klu mi yi byad sde

/zhe brgyad lha 'dres mnan cing bsdams pa dang : 'byung ba lnga la gtad mnan byas pa kunaḥ mi gnas mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings su bzlogaḥ hū bye khro rgyal che bsatsan rdo rje gtsug tor kyisaḥ bka' nyan pho nya ye shes sgo ma bzhiḥ zhi mdzad dung gi bya rgod mgo can gyisaḥ shar phyogs byad byur gtad mnan 'phrul 'khor bzlog rgyas mdzad gser mdog stag gi mgo can gyisaḥ sa yi phyogs nas byad byur gtad mnan bzlogaX dbang mdzad zangs kyi srin bya'i mgo can gyis0 nub phyogs byad byur gtad mnan 'phrul 'khor bzlogaḥ drag mdzad lcags kyi spyang ku'i mgo can gyis ༷ byang phyogs byad byur gtad mnan dgra la bzlogaḥ bka' nyan mgon po ma ning nag po yis bstanadagra zhing bcus dmod sbyor 'phrul 'khor bzlogaX spug nag 'od 'phro e ka tsa ṭi mas gsang sngags bstan la 'tshe ba'i dgra bdud bzlogaX lha mo dpal 'bar nad rims bdag mo yisaḥ 'jig rten kun gyi nad mug mtshon 'khrugs bzlog ༷ shan pa sgog sgrub las kyi pho nya yis shar nas sdang ba'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs bzlogaḥ gza' 'dud

dug sdong spu gri 'bar ba yis lho nas sdang ba'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs bzlogaḥ dam can rdor legs sprul ba'i 'khor tshogs kyis0 nub nas sdang ba'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs bzlogaX gnod sbyin shan dmar mi srun drag rtsal gyisaḥ byang nas sdang ba'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs bzlogaX thabs kyi rang bzhin mgon po pho rgyud kyisaḥ bstan la sdang ba'i dgra sde ma lus bzlog shes rab rang bzhin lha mo mo rgyud kyisaḥ bstan 'gro'i dpal 'phrog ma rig dgra sde gnyis med ma ning rdo rje'i ging tshogs kyisaX khams gsum rang bzhin dgra 'dre'i rgol ba sprul pa yang sprul nyang sprul bsam yas pas mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad legs nyes ltong 'dzin rdo rje'i gsang srog 'changaX bka' sdod pho nya yongs rdzogs lha la bstodaḥ dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor mar 'di bzhes laX ban byad bon byad lha klu mi yi byad sde brgyad lha 'dres mnan cing bsdams pa dang : 'byung ba lnga la gtad mnan byas pa kunaḥ mi gnas mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings su bzlog snyen badz+ra dz+nyā na sa twa kro ta ma ma hūṃ ni swāsnya

/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gtad mnan byad phur rbod gtong thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ e ka bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog bden pa'i stobs bzlog niḥ na mo mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden mthu dang bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden stobs dang ཿ khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor byin rlabs kyis ban bon zhung zhung mu stegs byad phur bzlogaX 'byung ba lnga la sbyor btab gtad mnan bzlogaḥ sde dpon sum cur bcol bas gtad mnan dpal mgon bdun cur gnyer bcol gtad sa bdag klu gnyan gtod bcol bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dgra stong phrag brgyad bcu'i bgegs rnams dgra gdon chen bco lngas rgol ba mo rtsis rmi lam ngan pa than dang ltas ngan cho 'brul dgra rta phyug nor gyi god yams steng nas thog ser 'khrugs pa bar nas sde brgyad yos kha 'og nas sa bdag klu nad dgra la mdze rigs bco brgyad lhog pa sgrang lo 'brum bu dkar nag dmar gsum dmar bshal sib dang bas ldag thor bo g.yan pa bzlog dreg dang

grum bu chu ser nad rnams yas nas bdud g.yos yo 'o/ga byed pa mas nas sri lang phung thal gtong chags che nyams nga gdug rtsub cho 'phrulaḥ rtags dang rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs rnams bzlogaḥ dus min 'chi rkyen tshe yi bar chad dpral bar gshed 'khor skye bo'i yos kha sngar 'das dur sri dur sgo lang ba gnam nas dal 'debs sa yi dug g.yos sme ba spar kha gegs bdud gshed long bzlog phung sri phung 'dre dam sri'i gnod pa bzlogaḥ thams cad ma lus dgra dang bgegs la bzlogaḥ rig sngags rbod gtong mkhan rnams tshar gcod cigaḥtabya thāḥ tsho a na le a na leḥ kha sa meḥ kha sa me be+e re be+e reḥ so me so meḥsharnye sharnyeḥ darnye darnye bi ṣa te bi ṣa te bi re bi reX de bi badz+ra dha ri bhan+ta ni hūṃ phaṭa swā hāX yo ma ma hūṃ ni swā& bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa phye phyes khrol khrolaḥ gtad mnan bzlog bzlog khyung bzlog ni hūṃ bh+yoḥ khro rgyal kun gyi phrin las stobs rdzogs pa ye shes khyung chen badz+ra ga ru ṇa'iḥ dam rdzas rmad byung bdud rtsi'i mchod

/sku pa dang ༷ sha khrag rus pa'i phung po 'di bzhes laḥ rnal 'byor mi mthun 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlogaḥ g.yas gshog ye shes khro bo chen po bcus: dge 'dun nang 'khrugs mi mthun nyes tshogs bzlogaX g.yon gshog las kyi khro bo chen po bcusaḥ rnal 'byor nang gi nyer 'tshe nyes tshogs bzlogaḥ mjug ma las spros rgyal mo gdong mo yisaX ma sring dbang phyug ltas ngan cho 'phrul bzlogaX gser gyi spyan mig nyi zla ltar 'khyil bsaḥ gza' dang rgyu skar lha gdon cho 'phrul bzlog lcags rwa nag po mtshon rtse ltar gzeng pas lha srin sde rgyad cho 'phrul dgra la spyi gtsug yid bzhin nor bu 'bar ba yisaḥ nor bu dbyig gi lta ngan dgra la lcags kyi sgro phran mtshon cha ltar rno bsaḥm rung mi mthun chags chen nyams nga bzlogaḥ dug sbrul nag po zhal du gsol ba yisaḥ sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyis rgol ba bzlogaḥ lcags sder bsgrad pas 'byung po'i snying nas 'drenaḥ sa gsum gdug pa'i cho 'phrul rgol ba bzlog ba dan rtse gsum g.yas su brdab pa yisaḥ pho gdon mo gdon klu gdon bzlog par byedaḥ ba dan rtse gsum g.yon

du brdab pa yis sa bdag klu gnyan gtod tshogs bzlog ba dan rtse gsum mdun du brdab pa yis rig sngags rbod gtong 'phrul 'khor ba dan rtse gsum 'og tu brdab pa yisaḥ byad gtad mnan pa'i 'khrul 'khor ba dan rtse gsum steng du brdab pa yis nyi zla gza' skar cho 'phrul bzlog par byed khro bo'i rgyal po khams gsum hūṃ sgra can khams gsum srid pa'i 'jig rten bh+yo yis thob zhing bcu tshangs ba'i dgra dang bgegs la rbad ༷ thams cad ma lus bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzodaX yo khrom ga ru ṭa hūṃ phaṭa sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog rtsang bzlog niḥ hū sto gru gsum 'bar ba e yi dkyil 'khor nasaḥ ma tram̐ lus la srin mo'i 'gros byed pa'i: drag po gdug pa'i rtsang phur brgya rtsa brgyadaḥ dug khrag dur sol ha la'i rdzas dgu byug rtse mo dur bya'i sha dang spu yis brgyanaX rtsa ba lce spyang sha zan rak+tas sbyar dbal ngar zhing bcu'i gzugs kyis rten la 'big ba su ta dang sngo dmar zhags pas bcingasaḥ thabs kyi dra ba mig mang ris su sharaḥ de la ma sring dbang phyug glog ltar 'byugs ye shes drwa ba skal ldan skyong ba'i sgor dam tshig

/di can gyi lha dmag bu yug 'tshubasaX lcags kyi drwa ba dam nyams bsgral ba'i snodaḥ gsod gcod pho nya mang po bu yug 'tshubasaX rtse mo ram̐ las bskal pa'i medapung 'baraḥ steng gdon cho 'phrul rgol ba sreg par byed rked par baṃ las chu 'dzin sbrang char rdolaḥ bar gdon dregs pa'i cho 'phrul 'jigs par byedaX rtsa bar ye lasabaskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshubasaḥ sa 'og gdon gyis rgol ba gtor brlag byedaḥ drag rtsal ya mtshan can gyi bka' sdod laḥ dmar chen rak+ta sha khrag gtor mas brnganaX dgra dang bgegs kyi snying la mā ra yaḥ zhing bcu yan par ma shor ki la ya ༷ byad gtad rbod gtong rig sngags bzlog mdzod cigaḥ kaḥs rachigaḥnyagyimāḥbaya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog byad phur gtad mnan rbod gtong thams cad bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ 'di yis mi bzlog gang yang med nus mthu gnam lcags thog dang 'dra tshe btsan rdzu 'phrul mtshungs zla dben no ngar byin rlabs bsam mtha'ayas bden rdzun lag tu longasadang gsal dkon mod rgyal khams 'gram dang mthong man ngag spu gri 'bar ba yi rdzong las byung ba'i gtad dkrugs skor slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po yis phyi rabs don phyir gter du sbas

gnyan po gamu rtser rgya yisabatabaḥ rten 'brel dusal bab pa'i tshe rgyal tshab sprul pas 'byin lung bstanaḥ de bar dregasapa sde bdun dang ཿ klu mo dung skyong dbang mor gnyer 'dod sred can la mi 'chor bar thugs sras rig 'dzin gang der sprod zhesapas bka' gtsug phyag rgyasabatabaḥ sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu bye brda thim snyiḥ zhesapa'ang lung zin grag pa'i dpal gyi bskul ba dang ཿ tshogs smon las 'dzomasashad po pad+ma dpon g.yog gi bkra shis dge ba'i skyesabacas nan tan chen pos bskul ngoraḥ 7 kho bo bdud 'dulacung drag rol pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba dge leg 'phel/ sarba maṅga la/

drag sngags me 'dus spu gri'i 'khor lo las rdo rje gtsug tor can gyi spyi'i zor las gnam lcags thog mda' ngar ma bzhugs soX na mo gu dra 'o/ kro ta rā dza yaḥ zo(rwa/4zanarma(141 bde ba'i mthar son stong pa'i gzugs ye shas phyag rgya 'bar ba'i gar khro chen rdo rje gtsug tor la rab tu dngas bas phyag sgrub mchog pho mo yis rang gzhan bstan 'gro'i don ched du rdo rje gtsug tor 'bar ba yaḥlas mtha' gtad dkrugs sbyor brtsam na zor las thog ga mda'u 'di dgra bgegs brlag pa'i tho lum yinaḥs ma māḥ 'bul ba ni kya skyabs gnas bslu med dkon mchog rin po che bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥr zor las kyi grogs mdzod cigaḥmado rgyud sems phyogs bka' dgongs phur gsum sogasaḥrgyud dang sgrub sde'i yi dam rgya mtsho yiḥbadud rtsi gser skyems bzhes laḥdrag po'i gtor zor las kyi grogs mdzod cigaḥ rdo rje rnal 'byor 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sprin chos skyong dregs pa pho mo ma ning rigasaḥbadud

/khu du gsol byang phyogs g.yu ldong ne+e sang gdol rigs rnams sngo nag gdug pa'i kha rlangs nad char g.yoḥ ru sbal smad g.yog chu srin gdan la bzhugs log rtog 'dul ba'i sha zung zhags pa 'dzinaḥ rang rang rigs kyi sde lnga'i 'khor gyis bskoraḥ gdol ba klu yi tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstodaX khyed la klu sman bdud rtsis mchod pa'abulaX ba dmar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar gsum dang ཿ mngar gsum bzang drug shel tshig mchod pa 'bulaḥ gdeng ga'i rgyan ldan sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas sku gsung thugs nyid mdangs dang ldan gyur cigaX klu rnams mdangs ldan brngan yon phul ba'i mthusaḥ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas rnamasaḥ ban bon bsam ngan rbod gtong sbyor ba yiḥ da sngon khyed rnams lag tu gtad gyur naḥ gtad pa dkrugs la bcings khrol mnan pa khyogasaX klu gdon gdug pa'i nad rnams bsal du gsol: srid pa'i dpal rtsol rgya mtsho'i gting rum nasaḥ rigs bzhi klu chen brgyad kyi pho nya baḥ stong khyab kun du dga' ba gter bum 'dzin chu srin gdan bzhugs rin chen sna lngas brgyan stong gsum klu

rgyal 'khor dang bcas la bstod: khyed la klu sman bdud rtsis mchod pa 'bul ba dmar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar gsum dang ཿ mngar gsum bzang drug shel tshig mchod pa 'bulaḥgadeng ga'i rgyan ldan sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcasaḥ sku gsung thugs nyid mdangs dang ldan gyur cigaḥ klu rnams mdangs ldan brngan yon phul ba'i mthusaḥ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas rnamasaḥ ban bon bsam ngan rbod gtong sbyor ba yiḥ da sngon khyed rnams lag tu gtad gyur na gtad pa dkrugs la bcings khrol mnan pa khyogs klu gdon gdug pa'i nad rnams bsal du gsol: rig sngags mthu grub khyung la mdza' ba yisaX ma seng mtsho sman 'ja' tshon 'od lnga 'khyugasaḥ nyi zla stong gi phreng bas lus la brgyanaḥ rang byung rang 'od 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugasaḥ sbrul chen rigs lnga'i sku la rab tu btudaX phyag na dngul dkar me long mda' dar bsnamasaḥ khams gsum dbang bsdud srid gsum sa ler gzigasaḥ sman lcam dgu khri dgu 'bum dbus na 'gyingaX phyag brnyan klu nad mang po pho nyar 'gyedaḥ khams gsum dbang bsdud mtsho sman rgyal mor bstodaḥ

/kyi khyed la klu sman bdud rtsis mchod pa 'bulaḥ ba dmar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar gsum dang ༷ mngar gsum bzang drug shel tshig mchod pa 'bulaḥ gdeng ga'i rgyan ldan sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcasaḥ sku gsung thugs nyid mdangs dang ldan gyur cigaX klu rnams mdangs ldan brngan yon phul ba'i mthus bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas rnamasaḥ ban bon bsam ngan rbod gtong sbyor ba yi da sngon khyed rnams lag tu gtad gyur naḥ gtad pa dkrugs la bcings khrol mnan pa khyogasaḥ klu gdon gdug pa'i nad rnams bsal du gsol / steng phyogs lha yi yul khams la rin chen mdzes pa'i pho brang pad gdan khar mi mjed bdag po tshangs dbang gser gyi mdogaḥphyag g.yas chags shing g.yon pas gter bum 'dzin btsun mo sras 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstodaX khyed la sogasarnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang 'ja' 'khyugs klongaḥlha dbang brgya sbyin dkar po dar ber gsol phyag na gser gyi rdo rje 'khor lo 'dzinaX glang chen 'gyeng bag brjed ldan chibs su bcibs lha 'khor bsam mi khyab la phyag

'tshal bstodaḥ khyed la klu sman bdud rtsis mchod pa 'bul ba dmar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar gsum dang ༷ mngar gsum bzang drug shel tshig mchod pa 'bul gdeng ga'i rgyan ldan sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas sku gsung thugs nyid mdangs dang ldan gyur cigaḥ klu rnams mdangs ldan brngan yon phul ba'i mthusaḥ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas rnamasaḥ ban bon bsam ngan rbod gtong sbyor ba yi da sngon khyed rnams lag tu gtad gyur naX gtad pa dkrugs la bcings khrol mnan pa khyogasaḥ klu gdon gdug pa'i nad rnams bsal du gsol: rin chen sna bdun mdzes pa'i ri rab kharaḥ yul skyong 'phags skyes po dang spyan mi bzang rnam thos sras rnams dkar mthing dmar ser zhal mdzes pa'i rgyan spras phyogs skyong chen po bcuḥ rang rang rigs kyi sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas dgos 'dod char 'bebs lha yi tshogs la bstod khyed la klu sman bdud rtsis mtshod pa 'bul ba dmar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar gsum dang ཿ mngar gsum bzang drug shel tshig mchod pa 'bulaX gdeng ga'i rgyan ldan sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas sku

gsung thugs nyid mdangs dang ldan gyur cig klu rnams mdangs ldan brngan yon phul ba'i mthus bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams na bon bsam ngan rbod gtong sbyor ba yiḥ da sngon khyed rnams lag tu gtad gyur naX gtad pa dmigs la bcings khrol mnan pa khyogasaX klu gdon gdug pa'i nad rnams sal du gsol khams gsum dbang phyug ma hā de wa dang ཿ bhe snu rā dza khyab 'jug rā hu laḥ tshogs kyi bdag po garti ka dang niḥ dh+ring gi ri ti dga' byed dbang phyug rnams ra rang chung ma g.yog 'khor bcas la bstodaḥ khyed la klu sman bdud rtsis mchod pa 'bulaḥ ba dmar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar gsum dang ཿ mngar gsum bzang drug shel tshig drod pa 'bulaḥ gdeng ga'i rgyan ldan sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas sku gsung thugs nyid mdangs dang ldan gyur cigaḥ klu rnams mdangs ldan brngan yon phul ba'i mthus na ga dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas rnamasaḥ ban bon bsam ngan rbod gtong sbyor ba yiḥ da sngon khyed rnams lag tu gtad gyur na gtad pa dkrugs la bcings khrol

mnan pa khyogs klu gdon gdug pa'i nad rnams bsal du gsol: drang srong khyab pa chen po nam mkhar 'jug mthing nag mgo lus med par mig gis gang mgo dgu'i lha srin sde brgyad cho 'phrul 'gyed rnga ma du ba 'jug ring dgra la 'debs phyag na rwa yi mda' gzhus zhing bcu tsholaḥ zla ba lhag pa spen pa pa ba sang0 nyi ma mig dmar phur bu sgra gcan 'dzin gzas po'i gshed du gyur la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ khyed la klu sman bdud rtsis mchod pa 'bulaḥ ba dmar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar gsum dang ཿ mngar gsum bzang drug shel tshig mchod pa 'bulaX gdeng ga'i rgyan ldan sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas sku gsung thugs nyid mdangs dang ldan gyur cig klu rnams mdangs ldan brngan yon phul ba'i mthusaḥ bdag dang rgyu spyor yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams ban bon bsam ngan rbod gtong sbyor ba yi da sngon khyed rnams lag tu gtad gyur naX gtad pa dkrugs la bcings khrol mnan pa khyogasaḥ klu gdon gdug pa'i nad rnams bsal du gsol: drang srong phyag brnyan lha yi 'khor gyur pa smin drug la sogs shar gyi rgyu skar bdun0 'byung

ba shing la rgyu zhing dgra sha zaḥ mchu gre la sogs lho yi rgyu skar bdunaḥ 'byung ba me la rgyu zhing dgras drod 'phrogaḥ lha 'tshams la sogs nub kyi rgyu skar bdun rtseng ba lcags la rgyu zhing dgra rus 'thagaḥ mon gre la sogs byang gi rgyu skar bdunaḥ 'byung ba chu la rgyu zhing dgra khrag skemasaḥ ston pa'i bka' nyan legs nyes shan 'byed pa'i:skar nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod khyed la klu sman bdud rtsis mchod pa 'bulaX ba dmar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar gsum dang ཿ mngar gsum bzang drug shel tshig mchod pagyelaḥ gdeng ga'i rgyan ldan sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas sku gsung thugs nyid mdangs dang ldan gyur cigaḥ klu rnams mdangs ldan brngan yon phul ba'i mthus bdag dngasbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams ban bon bsam ngan rbod gtong spyor ba yiḥ da sngon khyed rnams lag tu gtad gyur naḥ gtad pa dmigs la bcings khrol mnan pagasaḥ klu gdon gdug pa'i nad rnams bsal du gsol:rnal 'phyor bdag gis gnyer du bcol ba yisaḥ gtad 'di ri bo'i rtse dang rgya mtsho'i gting mtsho dang chu mig brag

lam na zam shingaḥ lung gsum 'dus mdo pha waṃ phug pa sogasaX gang na yod kyang lha sngags phyag rgyas gziraḥ rang dbang med par mngon sum bdag la sprodaḥ gnam lcags thogasogs lha srin sde brgyad kyi cho 'phrul rtags dang mtshan ma dang bcas te: mngon sum ya mtshan snyan grags bskyed du gsol byad gtad rbod gtong ngan pa zhi bar mdzod deltar gtad phyung gtad bkrol 'dis no nus phrin las bsam mtha' yas slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po yisaḥ ngan sngags srog rgyud gzer las byung las 'phro can gyi dpal du bzhagaḥ mdo khams gnyan po g.yu rtser sbas la canagacig da 'phrad par shog ces pa 'i smon lam ci bzhan rnyedaḥ sa ma wāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ bdud 'dul khyung drag rtsal gyis gter ma'oḥ sarba ma la/

/sa drag sngags me 'dus spu gri'i 'khor lo las khyung nag rdo rje thog rgod rtsal gyi gtad phyung gtad bkrol bsdus pa thog mde'u ngar ma bzhugs soḥn mo gu ru bṛ kro ta rā dza yaḥ tsha'idzor+shar+sham5)sa ma 'o bstan 'dzan skyes bu rnams mtha' mi kla sgo'i dzos sbyor dang smon log bdud kyis gtad mnan sogs grol phyir thabs 'dir 'bad par byaḥ sam yāḥ sno 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nasaḥ bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje dang : rdul dang bral ba'i pho brang nas: 'jam dpal nā ga rā dza dang ༷ zla gam e yi klong dkyil nas:pad+ma dbang chen rta mchog rgyalaḥ dza lan+ta ra'i ba gam nasaḥ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang kun la gus pas skyabs su mchiḥ thugs rje sems can don mdzad cingaḥ bdag dang yon bdag srung du gsol: hūṃ rgya mtsho chen po'i sang dkyil nas: sa bdag stong khyab wa ri ṇaḥ stong gsum klu yi rgyal po dang tsang kun lto 'bye sa 'dzin legasaX sa yi lha mo brtan ma sogs 'jig jen srid pa'i sa bdag laX brngan yon mchod pa 'bul ba ni shing rtsi bal tshon shel tshig dang ཿ ri dgas g.yung dgas rtsa gnas gcan: gnyan bya kla bya'i sma

tshal dang ༷ dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi dang klu sman 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'diX bdag dang yon bdag don phyir du sa yi bdag po rnams la 'bulaḥ brngan yon phul ba'i byin rlabs kyis bsrung bya bdag cag yon mchod kun ban bon bsam ngan rbod sbyor kyisaḥ de snga khyed rnams la ni gtad gyur naḥ gtad pa sprugs la mnan pa khyogasaḥbazungs pa thong la bcings pa khrol klu yi rgyal po dga' bo dang ༷ nye dga' 'jog po stobs kyi rgyu pad+ma dung skyong rigs dang ldan rmig rgyu dang ni rmig rgyu cheX mtha' yas pad+ma chen po dang ཿ sogs ma med dang ru can dang ཿ rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs bram zelu gdol ba nag po klu yi bran: 'dzin shes gtong mi shes pa sogasaḥ mdze grum shu ba zha grum bdag khyed la brngan yon 'bul ba niX dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi dang 0 klu sman 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'bul ban bon bsam ngan rbod sbyor kyis be+e dkar rgyal po the'u rang dang ༷ lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs rnams bcas khyed rnams lag tu gtad gyur na: gtad pa dkrugs la mnan pa khyog bzungs pa thong la bcings pa khrol gnyan rje

/sku gong sngon a ma dros: ser bdag g.yu li thod gdeng canaḥshing la gnas pa'i shing gnyan dang ཿ chu la gnas pa'i chu gnyan dang ཿ sa la gnas pa'i sa gnyanadang ཿ nyi zla gza' skar lo zla zhagaḥ dus tshod la rgyu'i gnyan rnams kun: khyed la brngan yon 'bul ba niḥ dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi dang ཿ klu sman 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'bulaḥ ban bon bsam ngan rbod sbyor kyis be+e dkar rgyal po the'u rang dang ཿ lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs rnams bcasaḥ khyed rnams lag tu gtad gyur na: gtad pa dkrugs la mnan pa khyogaḥ bzungs pa thong la bcings pa khrolaḥ tsang kun khyab pa chen po dang ༷ sa bdag yak+ṣa sde lnga dang ཿ sa tshon dkar po'i bdag po ni stag dkar bya yi 'dab ma canaX sa tshon ser po'i bdag po niḥ gsum ser sha ba'i mgo bo can: sa tshon dmar po'i bdag po niḥ bya dmar me yi 'dabs ma canaX sa tshon sngon pa'i bdag po niḥ ru sbal g.yu yi phog bu can: sa tshon nag po'i bdag po ni glang nag mtshal gyi rwa co canaX sa bdag sde rigs thams cad la khyed la brngan yon 'bul ba niḥ dkar gsum mngar

(kyi gyi rtsibs steng du gshin rje'i bshan pa dmar nag g.yas sbrul zhags dang g.yon mda' gzhu 'dzin pa g.yon zur gyi rtsibs la grog gcod gyi shan pa nag po g.yas khram shing dang g.yon bdud kyi shwa rdo bsnams paX kun kyang zhing g.yang dang sbrul chun mgo phreng stag gzig smad sham spras shing zhabs gnyis gyad kyis 'dor stabs su bsgrad pa'oḥ de'i phyi rim shar stod kyi rtsibs stengs su steng gi khram bdag gshin rje nag po sku mdog mthing nagaḥ g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum g.yon dgra stu thogs paḥ shar gyi rtsibs steng du gshin rje gong tshe khrab gyon g.yas lcags kyi 'khor lo dang g.yon brag nag 'dzin paḥ shar lho'i rtsibs steng du a wa glang mgo sku mdog du kha g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon rgyu zhags 'dzin paḥ lho'i rtsibs steng du gshin rje mig dmar sku mdog dmar nag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon zhing dbyug thogs pa lho nub tu gshin rje rmig pa sku mdog khams nag g.yas thod phreng dang g.yon lcags sgrog 'dzin paḥ nub kyi rtsibs steng du gshin rje til ba sku mdog dmar ljang g.yas spra gri ngar ma dang gapon lcags kyi 'khor lo

thogs paḥ nub byang gi rtsibs la gshin rje bdud mkhar sku mdog dmar nag g.yas gri gug g.yon khram shing 'dzin paḥ byang gi rtsibs steng du gshin rje ljang nag g.yas be conadang g.yon sha zung bsnams pa byang shar gyi rtsibs steng du gshin rje phya sang sku mdog dkar po g.yas bum pa dang g.yon thod dbyugs 'dzin paḥ nub smad kyi rtsibs steng du 'ogagi khram bdag gshin rje dmar po g.yas pa'i skye 'gro'i rtsis byang dang g.yon rgyu zhags 'dzin paḥ kun kyang khros shing gtum la rngams pa'i gad rgyang sgrogs paḥ zhing g.yang dngasbrul chun mgo phreng stag sham klubs pa zhabs rnams 'dor stabs su bsgrad pa'oḥ de'i byi rim shar stod kyi rtsibs la steng gi khram bdag mi lus 'brug gi mgo can phyag na sridapa'i khram shing thogs paḥ shar gyi rtsibs steng du dri za'i khram bdag mi lus khra yi mgo bo can phyag na gser gyi khram shing thogs paX lho'i rtsibs steng du gshin rje'i khram bdagami lus sha ba'i mgo can phyag na mthing gi khram shing thogs pa nub kyi rtsibs steng du chu'i khram bdag mi lus glab gi mgo can phyag na zangs kyi khram shing thogs pa byang gi

/kyi rtsibs steng du gnod sbyin gyi khram bdag mi lus glang gi mgo can phyag na zangs kyi khram shing thogs paḥ byang gi rtsibs steng du gnod sbyin gyi khram bdag mi lus sbrul gyi mgo bo can phyag na lcags kyi khram shing thogs paḥshar lce'irtsibs steng du me yi khram bdag mi lus spyang ku'i mgo bo can phyag na rwa yi khram shi lho nub kyi rtsibs steng du srin po'i khram bdag mi lus dred kyi mgo bo can phyag na shing gi khram shing thogs paḥnub byang gi rtsibs steng du rlung gi khram bdag mi lus dom kyi mgo can phyag na chu'i khram byang shar gyi rtsibs steng du bgegs kyi khram bdag mi lus gzig gi mgo bo can phyag na rus pa'i khram shi nub smad kyi rtsibs steng du 'og gi khram bdag mi lus bong bu'i mgo bo can phyag na mi mgo'i khram shing thogs pa kun kyang g.yon rnams bhan+ta dmar gyis bkang ba 'dzin zhing zhing g.yang mgo phreng sbrul chun stag gi sham thabs can zhabs gnyis gyad gyis 'dor stabs su bsgrad cing rngams pa'i nga ro ngoms par bskyed doX de'i phyi rim gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i shar gyi rtsibs steng du dri

zas rgyal po bya rog gi mgo can sku mdog dkar po lag na byad thags ser po spro ba lho'i rtsibs steng du gshin rje'i rgyal po bya rog gi mgo can sku mdog sngo nag lag na byad thags nag po spro ba nub kyi rtsibs steng du klu bdud nag po sbrul gyi mgo can sku mdog dmar nag lag na zangs kyi byad thags thogs pa'o byang gi rtsibs steng du gnod sbyin rgyal po ra yi mgo can sku mdog ljang nag lag na byad thags mthing nag spro zhing mi sdug rngams pa'i khro 'gying can mi lpags mgo phreng sbrul chun stag sham klubs par bskyed do de'i phyi rim gtum la khros pa'i 'jigs rngams can dregs pa bco brgyad po 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha phyag las 'gyed cing ཿ gdug pa'i kha rlang lho sprin ltar 'tshubs paḥ yus rngams kyis gsod gcod dgra la 'gyed pa rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung sna tshogs su bsgyur zhing mgyogs pa rta la zhon nas thog ser me rlung 'tshubs bzhin du gnas par bskyed doḥ'agugs 'dren ni bdag nyid lha yi thugs ga'i sa bon las: 'od zer sna tshogs lcags kyu ltar 'phros pasaḥ sa 'og dpag tshad bdun gyi lcags mkhar nas: 'chi bdag gshin

/sku rje 'khor bcas bkugs par dmigasaḥ dza ༷hūṃ baṃ ho badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥn ma rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyibaka' bden pa dang ༷ sangs rgyas kyi bka' chos kyi dge 'dun gyi khyung nag rdo rje thog rgod rtsal gyi bka' bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden rnala'abyor ba bdag gi la sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa chen pos mthus 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig yud tsam la rū pā 'dirnams la mchis par gyur cigaḥ ṭā ki rā dza hūṃ dzaḥdzaḥ/ rba hoḥ lan bdun brjodaḥhūḥ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal loḥ mkha' lding rgyal po'i bden stobs kyisaḥ khamasagasum 'dir gnas su yang rungaḥ nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig gal te bka' khur dam 'da' naX de nyid rdul du brlag par nus de phyir de ring rgyu sbyor dang rnal 'byoradapon gob 'khor bcas laḥ gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra dang bgegasaX 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po dang ༷ sgog gcod shan pa lag dmar tshogs bla tshe srog gsum gtad

mnan pa'iḥ gnyer bzhes gang dang su yin pa rang dbang med par 'dir khug cigaḥtri a ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ paṃ hoḥlan gsumaḥbadag nyid ste ru ga'i sku gsung thugs las 'phrosapa'i pho nya lcags zhags sgogs dril thog pa grangs med pas 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas mdun gyi dam tshig bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor la sib sib bstim mo badz+ra adru sha dza rat+na pa sha 〉ཿ pad+ma spo ṭā baṃḥ karma ghan+ḍi ho0 spyan 'dren niḥ ce gson cig dgongs shig dkon mchog gsum: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho dang ༷ gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sprinaX dam can rgya mtsho'i gzu dpang mdzod0 bdud rtsi skyems phud 'di bzhes laḥ byad gtad rbod gtong bkrol ba dang tshe srog nyams pa sor chud mdzodaX stsa 'jig rten 'di yi lho phyogs su dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol nas0 thod pa lcags kyi sku mkhar nang rngams brjid ma he'i khri steng nas pho nya yi dwags kun gyi rjeḥ sgog 'phrog gshin rje yongs kyi dpon0 gson po rnams kyi skos 'debs mkhanaḥ shi ba kun gyi srog gi bdudaḥ dge ba mkhan kyi sdong grogs

/sku so sdig pa can la chad pa mkhanaḥ legs nyes chos bzhin spyod pa po 'chi bdag gshin rje mthu rtsal canaḥ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan 'bod cing bskul lo da tshur byonaḥ phan dang byams pa'i sems kyis gshegasaḥ gnod dang gdug sems bral mdzod cigaX ya ma ra tsa sa pā ri wa ra a ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang bskur ba ni 〉ཿ bcom ldan bde shegs rigs lnga poX mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas suX gshin rje rnams la dbang bskur bstsalaX dbang rtags rdo rje rtse lngas brgyanaX a bhi ṣiñca sa ma ya stumaḥ badz+ra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bzhugs gsol ni hūṃḥ ya las grub pa'i rdzu 'phrul canaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje 'khor dang bcasaḥ dam tshig dbang gi gdan 'dir 'khod bdag gis mchod sbyin 'di bzhes laḥ byad phur gtad mnan bkrol du gsolaḥ tshe ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hoḥ phyag 'tshal ba ni shāḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po ni sku mdog mthing nag mun lngar 'khyelaḥ lngags kyi ral pa mi mgos barbanaḥ pyag mtshan lngags zhags bam chen 'dzinaḥ 'khor bcas yongs la ma 'a dbang byed phrin las rjo ngar chong

las mgyogs chibs su ma he glang rgod bcibasaḥ 'jig rten khams kun mnga' dbang bsgyuraX bde gshegs sku yi gsang 'dzin paḥ drag shul can la phyag 'tshal ma sa ma yā na mo ho mchod 'bul niḥ hūḥ 'jig rten 'jig par byed pa poḥ ya las grub pa'i rdzu 'phrul canaḥ khyod la dgyes pa'i dam rdzas niḥ dbang lnga'i me tog sha chen sbosaḥ zhun me mkhris pa'i dri chab dang ༷ sha rus zhal zas rkang gling rnga 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa'i sprin dug gsum gnas stong sman gtor rakaX 'chi bdag gshin rje khyod la 'bulaḥbyad gtad rbod gtong bzlog tu gsolaḥ o ya ma rā tsa sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra 41 sogs bha pra tits+tsha ye swāhāX oṃ ya ma ra tsa sa pā ri wa ra rū pa shabha gharnye ra sa gas pañca a dṛ ta rak+ta bā ling ta khā —༷ gtor skyems bshams la na moḥ mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum dang bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthus bdag dang sbyin bdag la gnod sbor rbod gtong brtsam pa'i byad ma rnams sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: 'gugs gzhugs lan gsum byaḥ dza hūṃ baṃ ho pra we sha ya phaṭaX sha ri khrag gi rgya mtshor

tswakhu gyur bar bsamaḥ uḥ/ ha ho hrīḥ kyi 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po la byad gtad rbod gtong 'akrol ba'i yonaX bla tshe bsod nams bslu ba'i yas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ byad ma rang gshed dbab pa dang 0 gnod pa'i dgra sde ming med mdzod oṃ ya ma rā tsa sa pā ri wa ra e rda bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan bdun gyas phul bstod pa ni hūṃX 'jigs byed dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku skye 'gro'i sgog bdud khram shing rtsis byang 'dzin: legs nyes shan 'byed me long yig chung dang ཿ las kyi bu chung dkar nag bran du bkol ban bon rbod gtong dam bsgrags gtad bcol na: khyed kyi lto ba mun pa rlung thub klongaḥ sa bdag klu gnyan gtod 'du dug ri'i kharaḥ tshud par gyur na deng 'dir bstan 'gro'i mgon sngags 'chang nga yis bka' bsgrags dam gzir nasaX gtor ma 'bul lo gtad phyung mnan pa khyogs bla rten tshe sgog bskus pa bdag la stsolaḥ phran las sgrab mdzad grogs kyi mchog gyur paḥ 'cha bdag ya marnya ka khyod la bstod nongs pa gang mchis ye shes thugs kyis bzhes 'khu ldog gdug rtsubs

dgra la bstan mdzod cigaḥ de nas sbyin bdag gi sku glud 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i bkod pa rnams gshin rje la bsngo ba niḥ o āḥhūḥ sbyo las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du glud dang gtor ma chang bu 'bras chan sha khrag rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur oṃ na maḥs man+ta brnya rna na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃḥ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i ma' brjod mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa 'chi bdag bshin rje rgyal po la sogs pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la 'bul loḥ bdag dang rgyu sbyor ba yon gyi bdag po'i tshe 'khor ba thogs med nas da lta thugs gi bar du tshe dang srog gi lan chags sbyangs ba'i slad du bsngos nas 'bul loḥ bu lon 'khor lan chags bral0 sha mkhon byang bar gyur cig de ltar lo grangs su bsngo ba'am ci 'byer 'bulaḥ'achi bdag gshin rje'i srog bdag sde lnga 'chi bdag gshin rje'i khram bdag bdud po bcu la sogs 'chi bdag gshin rje'i srog gcod shan pa bcu la sogs 'chi bdag gshan rje'i phyag brten byad thag sde bzhi la sogs— phrin las bcol ba ni kye 'chi

31 bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po dang ༷ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu laX bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag giḥ tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i b.raḥ len chags bu lan sha mkhon dang ཿ stong yon ma lus sbyangs ba'i phyiraḥ sku glud 'dod yon 'di bsngos pasaḥ tshe sgog bar chad zhi bar mdzodaḥ lus ngag yid la gnod spyor da ཿ 'gal rkyen gang yang ma mdzad cigaḥ de yas gshin rje'i rgyal po brngan de nas 'khor rnams brngan phyar 'dos dzos dang gtor ma lan chags rnams byin gyis brlabs pa niḥ yis swā bha wa sogs 'de sa rdzas rnamathangadza sa dbyings rang bzhin gyi stong pa ka nas dag pa nyid du gyuraX oṃ na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta bh+yo sogs mdos la dbang ba'i lha srin dregs pa can thams cad kyi rang rang gi yid spyod dang mthun pa'i 'dos rdzas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur0 3 badz+ra a dṛ ta kun li sogs mdos la dbang ba'i lha srin dregs pa thams cad la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyuraḥ bla na ma sarba ta tha ga ta a wa sogs mdos la dbang b.lilha srin dregs pa

can rnams kyi spyan lam du shar ba'i mdos rdzas rnams longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po nyid du gyur bar bsamaḥ ma dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te sogs mdos la dbang ba'i lha srin dregs pa can rnams kyi yid spyod du shar ba'i mdos rdzas rnams la 'thab rtsod med cing mthun pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par gyur: ma na maḥs man+ta bhu ta rna sogs mdos la dbang ba'i lha srin dregs pa can rnams dam tshig la gnas shing sems can yid la phan pa'i bsam pa dang ldan par gyur: de nas nang gi 'khor khram bdag lnga pa la gtor ma 'bul ba ni 〉ཿ nga ni 'khor 'das kun gyi dpalaX nga ni srid pa gsum gyi bdag rdzu 'phrul khro rgyal dag dang mnyam rig sngags smon lam mthu las grubaḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang bskur zhingaḥ rig 'dzin rnams kyi grogs su bskulaḥ mkha' lding rgyal po gser mig 'khyil sku yi che bas lha srin 'dul gsung gi nga ros klu gnyan 'daraḥthugs kyis gzigs pas gshin rje brgyudaḥ yon tan phrin las bsam mtha' yas bka' bsgrags dam gzir byed lags na srog gcod 'chi bdag gshin rje'i tshogasaḥ

/kye thams cad ma lus bka' la nyonaḥ dam tshig bzhin du las mdzod cigaḥ smon log byad ma bsam ngan gyisaḥ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams da snga khyod la gtad gyur naX gtad phyungs byad bkrol mnan pa khyogs ༷ las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod bye gshin rje rgyal po'i sras mchog ni sku mdog dmar nag 'bar ba rtsalaḥ g.yas na bdud kyi khram shing thogasaḥ g.yon pas mi ro bam chen bsnamasaḥ khyed la sha khrag gtor ma dang ༷ chang bu 'bras chan mang po 'bulaḥ bdag dang rgyu spyor yon bdag rnamasaḥ ban bon rbod gtong sbyor ba yisaX da sngon khyod la gtad byas nasaḥ khram la btab na khram kha phyesaḥ gtad du bcug na gtad pa dmigasaḥ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ sbyoḥ las kyi gshin rje'i dgyes bskyed yum dur khrod ma mo tsa mun+tiX sgog dbugs 'phrog pa'i mthu rtsal can sku mdog dmar nag 'bar ba laḥ phyag g.yas khram shing g.yon thod khragaḥ dgra bo'i srog 'phrog dbugs gi bdagaḥ khyed la sha khrag gtor ma dang chang bu 'bras chan mang po 'bulaX bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams
