(sku nas byon pa'i klu rigs rnams yon bdag mchod cing bskangs zin pas da ni bzhud cig gnas su bskyodaḥ bdag cag rmongs pas thab gzhob dngaḥ sha khrag zas spyod klu la 'gresaḥ de phyir las zin rang gnas gshegs lho nas gshegs pa'i klu rigs yon bdag mchod cing bskangs zin pasaḥ da ni bsdod cig gnas su bskyodaḥ bdag cag rmongs pas thab gzhob dngaḥ sha khrag zas spyod klu la 'gresaḥ de byir las zin rang gnas gshegs: nub nas byon pa'i klu rigs yon bdag mchod cing bskangs zin pas da ni bzhud cig gnas su bskyodaḥ bdag cag rmongs pas thab gzhob dngaḥsha khrag zas spyod klu la 'gresaḥ de phyir las zin rang gnas gshegs: byang nas byon pa'i klu rigs yon bdag mchod cing bskangs zin pas da ni bzhud cig gnas su bskyodaḥ bdag cag rmongs pas thab gzhob dang sha khrag zas spyod klu la 'gresaḥ de phyir las zin rang gnas gshegs: nongs pa gang song mthol lo bshagasaḥ klu yi thugs 'gal bzod par gsol da ni bskyod do rang gnas bskyodaX da ni

gshegs so rang gnas gshegasaX da ni bsdu'o rang gnas bsdu: sa ma yā mūḥ tshogs gsol ni ye chosanyid bden pa mi bslu bsaḥ chos can rten 'brel phun sum tshogasaX yonabadag bsam pa 'grub lags pas klu rnams rgya mtsho' dbyings su gshegasaX sa bdag dbang chen gser gzhir gshegasaḥ gnyan rnams bar snang yangs par gshegs gtod sde 'byung ba lnga sang gshegasaḥ rgyal chen rigs bzhi mkha' la gshegasaḥ lha brgyad dga' ldan gnas su gshegasaX gza' brgyad go la'i pho brang gshegs phyogs skyongarang rang gnas su gshegs rgyu skar nam mkha'i pho brang gshegasaḥ gnod sbyin nor skyong rang gnas gshegs: klu yi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir 'khod pa'i gtso 'khor sprul pagayog de ring gshegs so gnas su bzhud de ring lam sna dbyings su bstan: sgo ba rnams kyis sgo phyes shigaḥ 'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang sol cigaḥ bzhud do rang rang gnas su gshegasaX dar gyi yol ba mtha' nas bsdusaḥ shing rtsi mthun rdzas klu gnas sbungs0 pha myes rgan rabs tshun chad dang bu dang tsha bo yang tsha tshun klu la 'khon 'gres

/sku mi 'byung b.raḥ gnas 'gron lta bu'i dam tshig giḥ phan tshun bsam pa 'grub gyur cig dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni bdag nyid he ru ga'i thugs srog las 'od zer spros shing ri dwags g.yung dwags 'dod rdzas rnams la phogaḥ de rnams 'od lngar zhu ste dpal mgon rnams la thimaX de rnams 'od zhu sgo skyong klu nor gyi bdag po rnams la thim de rnams lo lha bcu gnyis la thim: de rtsa kun mched brgyad la thimaX de klu chen rigs lnga la thimaḥ de klu chen brgyad la thimaḥ de stong gsum klu'i rgyal po la thimaḥ de klu rgyal sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la thimaḥ de thugs ga'i āḥ la thimaḥ ā nam mkha'i 'ja' yal ba bzhin chos sku mkha' khyab de bzhin nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go zig bsdu ni rmāḥ 'byung ba'i lha mo thig le 'dzin ma'i mkharaX rin chen sna lngas mi 'gyur thig gdab pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gzi byin phabaX klu la brten nas gdul bya'i re 'dod sgrub klu yi bdud rtsi chos kyi char bas bsil da ni mkha' mnyam byang chub sems 1nga grolaḥ thig tshon rang bzhin 'od gsal dbyings su snye gzhi 'di'i rdul rnyed

rgyal ba'i zhing gyur teḥ 'gro khams dongs sprugs mdzad pa lhun grub shogaX bden brjod ni na moḥ dang po klu skyes chu la skyesaḥ bar du klu gnas chu la gnas: tha ma thim yang chu la thimaX chu khams ma ki'i klong du grol gyur cigaḥ dang po gnyan skyes ri la skyes bar du gnyan gnas ri la gnas tha ma thim yang ri la thimaḥ ri bo rin chen 'od zhing grol bar shog dang po sa bdag sa las skyesaX bar du sa bdag sa la gnasaḥ tha ma thim yang sa sa khams sangs rgyas sbyan mar grol gyur dang po gtod skyes shing la skyesaḥbar du gnas kyang shing la gnasaX tha ma thim yang shing shing khams dam tshig sgrol mar grol dang po dregs pa brag las skyes bar du gnas kyang brag tha ma thim yang brag brag khams gos dkar klong du grol gyur cig: dang po 'jig rten mkha' las skyes bar du gnas kyang mkha' tha ma thim yang mkha' thams cad kun tu bzang 57ra 17la gyur cigaḥ de ltar klu bdud mdos gzhung dang ཿbcos dkar mtha' da sde brgyad kyi khram phyas 'byung lnga'i byad grol bcas ma tshang kha bskangs rim pa rnams ma lus rdzogs par bkod pa 'o sa ma yuḥ

/gro e ma slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po yi thugs kyi yang bcud man ngag skor drag sgrub gto gzhus chen po lasaḥ sa bdag klu yi gtad sprugs skor bstan 'gror phan bde spel ba'i phyar mdo khams g.yurtse'i gnas la sbas ma 'ong snyigs ma lnga yi dus nad mug mtshon chas gze lang tsheḥ nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa rgyal ba mchog dbya sa mi yi zol nus ldan dpal gyi rdo rje yis bstan 'gro'i rgud pa bsal phyir 'don bka' 'daklu mo du skyo dang / dregs pa sde bdun dag la gnyer dam nyams lag tu mi 'chor bar thugs sras rag 'dzin dpal du sprodaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda thamaḥ3niḥ zhes pa'adi'ang lu zin grags pa' dpa la kyis bkra shas rtags ldan gar yol dang lha reg gsang sngags kyi rdzas du mar bcas te bskul ba dang / tshogs smon las kyi 'phro 'dzoms zhang lha go ma dge btsun pad+ma nas bkra shis lha reg dbyangasasnyan chos dung mi 'gyur 'bol gdan gas sngags kyi rdzas dza gad kyi skyes bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo klong yangs nam mkha'i rnal 'byor bdud 'dul bzhi pa khyung drag rol pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brdamadzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge ni skye ba du mar brgyud pa 'i 'brel ldan shrī lha dharmas bgyis pa thog mtha' bar gsum kun du dge bar gyur cig/ sarba ma le/

/sku khram shing rdo rje tho bas brdung ba niḥ bh+yoḥ chos dbyings rang bzhin 'gyur med gdod nas dag chos can rgyu 'bras rten 'byung baspu med mthusaX ban byad bon byad kun rgyu kla kla'i byadaḥ stong gsum byad phur rdo rje'i tho bas brdung lha klu nor srung gza' byad rgyu skar gyi byad gtad mnan zor rig sngags rbod gtong kunaḥ ming gi lhag mar rdorje'i tho bas brdungaḥ dgra sna gyod sna 'phar sna spyang sna dabhe ཿ mi nag dmod byad skye bo'i yos kha kun phyir bzlog rang gshed dbab phyir tho bas brdungaX dgra mgo ldog pasabajis nas chems chem mnan bgegs dpung tho bas brdung nas thal thal gtoraX mngon spyod drag po'i bzlog las mthar phyin mdzodaḥ gshin rje'i mdos gzhung las so glud mdosalas bh+yo gdab ni bh+yo nam mkha' lha yi byad sna yang byad ma sbod gtong mkhan la bh+yoḥ bar snang gnyan gyi byad kha yang byad ma sbod gtong mkhan la bh+yoḥ gling bzhi srid pa'i byad kha yang byad ma stod gtong mkhan la bh+yoX sa gzhi klu gnyan byad gtad yang byad ma sbod gtong mkhan la bh+yo dgra la bh+yo bzlog ming med mdzodaḥ bgegs la bh+yo bzlog dum bur

gtubs byad kyi 'khrul 'khor bshigs du gsolaḥ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoX bzlog bzlog bzlogaX khrus kyi sbyangs bkru bya khro rgyal rdo rje gtsug tor de mchod do oṃ ā hūṃ rigs sngags grub pa'i rgyal mo de rdo rje'i mchu can rigs bzhi de phyogs bcu'i gdon 'dul khro bcu de las mdzad sgo skyong mkha' 'gro bka' sdod dregs pa sde bdun gter srung dung skyong nor ster rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho de mchod do span mo za lam bams soḥ hūṃ hūṃ ྅ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoX re ma ti sogs srid pa'i lcam mo'i tshogs rang rang ming po'i bka' bsgyur khram kha bzlog khro rgyal mdung dmar can gyis dgra bgegs sgolaḥ dpal chen 'khor bcas dgra bgegs rdul du rlogaḥ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaX sa ma ya bh+yoḥ drag sngags me 'dus lasaX gtad sprugs klu'i bsang 'a11na rnams brngan cing rang gnas su bsdu ba ni na mo gu ru yaḥ bzang shang sna tshogs dud pa btangaḥ phye mar klu sman shel dzig sbyar sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgyur spel khyung nag nga rgyal ldan pa yis kyeḥ rgyal ba kun dngos slob dpon pad+ma yiḥ bka' dam la gnas stong khams 'jig rten gyi sa bdag glu gnyan gtod kyi sde rigs dang

/sa yul lha gzhi bdag bdud rtsi bsang 'gron rnams gshegs skyems 'dod yon bsang mchod 'di bzhes la 'khu sdog khro 'khrugs nam yang mi mdzad cing byad gtad rigs sngags rbad mthu mi len paraḥ rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs su gsolaḥ rnal 'byor bdag gis sgrub pa byed tsa naḥ yon mchod gnas 'gron dam tshig dag pa yis: las kyis 'bras bu mchis pa'i grogs mdzod cigaX bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃḥ bsang mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsamaḥ 'di ya las kyis cha laganyu nus ldan rol ba'i rdo rje yis pad+ma' mos 'dod bskang phyir bris dge bas 'gro phan 'grub gyur cig/ sarba maṅga la/

/kyi zil gnon khyung gi gzir ba niḥ e skye med chos dbyings nam mkha'i sang dkyil nasaḥ 'gags med thig le rigs sngags grub pa'i rgyal: rdo rje gtsug tor bka' yi pho nya ba dug khyung nag po spu gri'i sgro gshog canaḥ thogs med stobs kyis 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs rmad byung gtor ma dza gad mchod pa bzhesaḥ klu rnams mchod bskang bsgrubs pa mtha' phyin nasaḥ brngan mdos nam mkha'i mtha' mnyams bstabs byas teḥ rang gnas gshegs rjes sa yi dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ klu phran phal ba gnyug gnas glo bur lhag: 'byung po 'dir 'khod rgyu bar byed pa rnams rang gnas la bzlog gnod 'tshe 'byu ba kun: mi gnas stong pa chen por mtshams chod cigaḥ tshe khro ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭaX klu gdon gdug pa can rnams ma ra ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ nus ldan pas so/ gtad dmigs phur bu dngos grub du blang ba na nyu /sa mi mngon chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba nas khro ba'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug tor can: nang dbyings bde ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor las0 gdul bya'i re skong phyi gsal gzugs kyi sku dgra bdud zil gnon dbal phur ngar

ldan pa ye shes khyung lnga dug gi gnyen po'i tshul phyogs skyong zil gnon ye shes khro bo bcuḥ dbal ngar che brjid badz+ra ki la yaḥ dgra bdud dam sri'i snying la gzer b.limatshon lha bdud klu gnyan gtod las rnam par rgyal: deng 'dir skal bzang bu yi dpal du shar lha srung g.yas su rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags dang : dam can g.yon du rgyal ba'i ru mtshon rtags sngags pa mchog tu rgyal ba'i don rtags dbang skal ldan rig 'dzin pho mo rnams la gtad nus mthu gnam lcags thog 'dra'i stobs ngar bskyed bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i skal ba ldan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub dbyigaḥ mi ring da lta nyid du thob gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ki la ya0 āX badz+ra ki la yaX hūṃ badz+ra ki la ya sirnyi tha la skyed āḥhūṃ hrīX dngos grub gnas gsum la btugs pas che btsan yon tan dpal thob 'gyuraḥs ma yuḥ'adi yang nus ldan rdo rjes zhi po pad+mas mos ngor spel ba dge'o/ mnga' gsol bum par dngos grub du zhu ba ni nyu hrīḥ chos dbyings kun zlum 'od 'khyil bum pa niḥ rin chen sna bdun gzhal med khang mdzes nangaX gza' klu dregs pa sde rgyad bsnol ba'i khar khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gtsug

/sku tor can ye shes khyung lnga 'bar ba'i khro rdul 'khrigs bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu mi g.yel b.raḥ rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po bstan pa dang dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i phyiraḥ thugs mchog mi 'gyur dpal gyi be'u nasaḥ gsang ba mchog gi sirnyi ma lus stsolaḥ lha dang gnyis med 'grub pa'i skal bzang thob dgra bdud bgegs las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo mdzod oṃ badz+ra kro dha gizhi ṣa sarba kum bha pa ti a la la ho bum chu khyung dang khro tshogs du dmigs la myang bas nad gdon nyer 'tshe sra gegs thams cad ma gnas par sang bar bsam mo 'di yang pad+ma' mos ngor nus ldan pas so/

/sku drag sngags me 'dus spu gri'i 'khor lo las: khyung nag rdo rje thog rgod rtsal gyi bka' nyan klu'i gtad dkrugs kyi cha lag gtad sel bcu gsum pa phrin las rno ba'i mde'u bzhugs soḥ rmi na mo gu ru kro ta rā dza ya sgo stonaspyonaja ba chenasgo rin chen sa yi gzhi steng du 'gres sdum bzang drug klu sman dang sbyar bas dkar gtor sman sdong dang ཿ 'brang rgyas zhal dkar klu bshos dang ཿ sman leb g.yag lug ra gsum bkod shing rtsi bal tshon shel tshig dang ཿ 'o phud bul bzhan 'di skad gyer snyenayos ka pa/ sogs ren pa che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar 'gres bsdum gyi gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum bzang drug klu sman shel tshig bya spu shing rtsi bal tshon 'bras lug 'bru dkar gtsang ma'i g.yag dang ra'i mchod pa sogs thugs dang mthun pa'i 'dod yon zad mi shes pa'i dkor nor gtad krugs byad bkrol ba'i brngan yon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyuraḥ.oṃ āḥtī nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum brjod kyi gangs dkar rtse dang smran ri'i rtseX pad can rtse ljon lngan rtseḥ ri rtse dag la gnas pa yi sa bdag sngong khyab mtha' yas dang ཿ

nam mkha' kun byed dbang po dang ཿ gtsug lags 'phrul gyi lde mig dang ༷ bang mdzod mkhar kyi dkor srung dang ཿ khams gsum khyab pa chen po sogs 'jig rten srid pa'i mnga' bdag la 'gres bsdum dkar gtor sman sdong dang klu bgos sman dang dkar gsum mngaraḥ bzang drug me tog shing rtsi b.laḥ dung phreng dung tshe shel tshig dang ཿ bya rigs gzugs 'gro'i g.yag lugs ra thugs mthun mchod sprin ting 'dzin dkor zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzod thams cad ma lus 'bul bgyi'oX bdag cag dpon sgob yon mchod kunaḥ ban bon rngod gtong bsam ngan gyis khyed rnams lag tu gtad srid na: brngan yon mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥ gtad pa dmigs la mnan pa khyogaḥbazungs pa thongs la bcings pa khrol bsdams pa 1da la gas pa sbyor chad pa mthud la ral ba grubaḥ zad pa gsos la yo ba srangs sgrub pa dbu nas mthar phyin par rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po bcas gtad sel phrin las ma 'khyang stsolaḥ rnal 'byor bka' bzhin las 'di mdzod zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel zhigaḥ ces ri bo'i rtse

/sku la gnyer gto pa'i gto sel zab ma'oḥsam yāḥkye ba gam mthon po'i yang rtse dang khang mgo'i lab rtse phyug mo dang ཿ gser mkhar khra bo dar bstod can bsang khri ri bo la brten pa'i gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong ba dang ཿ gdug cing rtsub pa nag phyogs rigasaḥ dkar nag gnyis skyongs khra bo'i sde pho mo ma ning rigs gtogs pa'iḥdregs pa yul lha gzhi bdag sogasaḥ sa 'khor 'di ru rten bcas laḥ'agres bsdum dkar gtor sman sdong dang ཿ klu bshos sman dang dkar gsum mngaraḥ bzang drug me tog shing rtsi b.laḥ dung phreng dung tshe shel tshig dang ཿ bya rigs gzugs 'gro'i g.yag lugs ra0 thugs mthun mchod sprin ting 'dzin dkor zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzodaX thams cad ma lus 'bul bgyi'oḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kunaX ban bon rbod gtong bsam ngan gyisaḥ khyed rnams lag tu gtad srid na: brngan yon mchod pa 'di bzhes la gtad pa dkrugs la mnan pa khyog bzungs pa thongs la bcings pa khrolaḥ bsdams pa 1da la gas pa spyor chad pa mthud la ral ba grub zad pa gsos la yo ba

srangasaX sgrub pa dbu nas mthar phyin par rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po bcasaX gtad sel phrin las ma 'khyang stsolaX rnal 'byor bka' bzhin las 'di mdzodaḥ zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel zhig ces lab rtse gnyan po la bcol ba'i gtad sel zab ma'oḥs ma yu kye brag ni dkar dmar nag dang khra ser po sngo ljang la brten pa'iḥ mi dkar rta dkar lha yi btsanaX mi ser rta ser gnyan gyi btsan mi dmar rta dmar brag gi btsan mi nag rta nag bdud kyi btsan mi khra rta khra dmu yi btsan mi sngon rta sngon klu yi btsan mi ljang rta ljang gtod kyi btsanaX btsan rigs ma lus thams cad la 'gres bsdum dkar gtor sman sdong dang ༷ klu bshos sman dang dkar gsum mngaraḥ bzang drug me tog shing rtsi bal dung phreng dung tshe shel tshig dang ཿ bya rigs gzugs 'gro'i g.yag lugs ra thugs mthun mchod sprin ting 'dzin dkor zad mi shes pa nam mkha'i mdzodaḥ thams cad ma lus 'bul bgyi'oḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kunaḥ ban bon rbod gtong bsam ngan gyis khyed rnams lag tu gtad srid na: brngan yon mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥ gtad

/sku cigaḥ tshe khro ga ru ṇa dug khyung tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭaḥ ka ya a bhi ṣiñca tshe khyung sku gtad laḥhūḥ khro rgyal rngams pa'i gtsug na spa gdug pa 'dul ba'i phrin lasacan: dug khyung 'bar bas dbang bskur roḥ nyon mongs bdud las rnam rgyal shogaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya ral gri gtad la (ཿ steng 'og bar gsum dregs tshogs dang ཿ sabadag klu gnyan gtod tshogs kyisaX bcings bsdam byad gdon nad thag kunaḥshes rab ral gris dum bur gtubasaḥ 'jigs pa'i tshogs las rnam rgyal ba'iḥ 'bar ba lasakyi dbang thob regagaX rtsa sngags mtharaḥ kā ya phur bu gtad laḥ / ༷ byad rnams ma lus grol ba dang nad gdon ma lus bsal ba dang ༷ gtad rnams kun las dbugs dbyung byir thal 'byin phur bu'i dbang bskur roḥ rtsa sngags mthar kā ya me'i dbang bskur ba niḥ/༷ snang tshad mtshan ma'i bag chags dang ༷ lhan skyes gdon gyis rgol ba kun: sor rtog ye shesaklong grol phyiraḥ drag po me yi dbang bskur roḥ rtsa sngags mtharaX kwa ya chu'i dbang bskur ba ni hūṃḥ chos nyid rlan gyi ye shes chusaX nyon mongs dri ma bag chags bcasaḥ me long ye shes

gzi mchong mgul rgyan byasaḥ lha klu'i bu mor 'dran dpe tshugaḥ mdzes pa'i mgo zhwa rkang lhum yangaḥ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal chas dang mtshungasaḥ zad med de ni nam mkha' mdzod gcig las brgya stong sa ya 'bum phung med de ni sgyu ma'i nor yid la 'dod pa'i re ba 'jo nyon mongs mi mnga' gtsang ma'i lus mkhon 'dzing mi dgos ya mtshan cheX khyed snang srid lha 'dre yongs la bsngoḥ gzugs bzang skye tshang ya mtshan can rgyu sbyor yon bdag glud du bzhes (4)kye nga ni sngagasakyi dbang phyug yin snang srid lha 'dre tshur nyon dang ༷ dpa' rtsal stobs rnams 'dzoms pas na glud la mdzes pa'i mda' yis brgyanaḥ g.yang nor mkho dgu 'dzoms pas na glud la bkra ba'i 'phang gis brgyan thabs mchog blo rtsal stobs ldan pa'i glud la pho tang stag chas bkodaḥ shes rab rgyu rtsal bde 'byor ba'i glud la mo gdong dar chas bkod phung bdud dal kha bzlog pas na glud la dbang po sgo lnga tshangasaḥ lha bdud dal kha bzlog pas na glud la bltas sdug gzugs byad 'dzoms 'chi bdud dal kha bzlog pas na glud la lo grangs khram shing btsugaḥ

//— bya shar bya wa gi mgo can mthing skya'oḥ kun gya mdun du glud nag po dgu g.yas su gtor ma nag po dgu rgyab tu glud 'brang khra bo dgu g.yon du khrag rkong nag po dgu mtshams su snying bsgos nag po dgu sngon du glang nag gru gu bkal ba dgu rgyab du khya nag ba su rol ba dgu ste du bya nag dug me za ba dgu de rgyab 'dod jos go khrab mchen gsum khyi ra phag gsumaḥ yos sbrul sbal gsumaḥ wa spyang spre gsum nya stong byi ba gsum sha khrag rus gsum thams cad legs pa ra bkod phya nang gi brgyang bu dang ༷ thugs mthun gyi nam mkha' spya'i nam mkha' mda' 'phang khram ris pho ting mo ting shing nag la bal nag gis brgyan pa ras zab dmar nag dang gcusamados nag po chos 'byung gi mtshan pa rgyan yo byad dang bcas pa bkod par bya'oḥ bcos dkar gyis mdun bshams la klu bshos thugs mthun gtor ma 'brang rgyas zhal dkar sman 'bras sman sdong mkhon sbyangs gtor ma dum zas pad+ma lta bu'i gtor ma dum nor 'gras bsdum gtor maḥ de dag gi rgyab sa stegs khar 'gras bsdum brgyang bu bcu gsum mdzes par bkod gzhan yang phye mar 'o phud klu sman gzugs 'gros me tog sna tshogs shing rtsi sna tshogs yang 'gras bsdum gtor ma rnams ni nyin bzhan du 'bul rgyu yan nad sel laḥ sa stegs chung bas khar klu sprul mgo lnga'i gdeng ka can smad sbrul 'jug g.yas su 'khyil ba lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba chu gnas sna

tshogs kyis bskor khyad par gter bum bzhi pad sdong bzhi ljon shi bzhi 'brang rgyas zhal dkar bzha mkhon sbyangs gtor ma bzhi dum zas bzhi rnams bkod la shing rtsi bal tshon rgyas brgyan noḥ gzer bdun rdul tshon gya rangamadog gyis re'u mig bcad kha dang bcas pa ra gcig gi rjes su gcig 'brang ba'i tshul du so sor bkod gtad sel bcu gsum la gtor gzhong bcu gsum gya khar rang lugs dkar tor nyi zla nor busabargyan pa g.yag lug ra gsumagazhan yang 'dod jos mchod thabs kyis yig chung ltar bkod nas shing rtsi bal tshon rang brgyang dar tshon gyis brgyan noḥ klu sman dang 'o chab yang sbyar gzhan yang tshogs chad bstan rgyun srol gyis gsol ka bskul ba gser skyemasamakhyen gzu'i gtor ma la pho mo gtor chung sogs gang dgos yo byad thams cad snga sor nas bsags la dus su bstabs ka 'grigs chags 'dzoms yag gal che 'oḥ rang byung sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyal po yis gdul bya'i re skongs chu bobazhi ldan par bskyed rdzogs las bzhis kha skongs ci bzhin du 'di na rab gsal dga' ba'i me long bzhad skal ldan 'jug bde phyag bzhes mi nyams par rgyu gtsang bkod legs yid 'ong shin tu gnad 'ad brtsams dge bamakha' khyab 'gro la bsngo kun kyang rgyal dbang pad+ma'i spyan snga rtsa sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan yongs rdzogs shog zhes pa'ang phun tshogs dbang skal 'dzoms pa zhing po pad+mas mos blos bskul ngor/ 7kho bo nus ldan rdo rjes gang dran

/skum thol byung du bris pa dge/ sarba maṅga la//glu las byang klu'i rta gon bum phur mnga' gsol srung dmigs byad ma 'bum rgyalaḥ dug phyung sposaphyung chab phyung / sgrub gzhung gnam lcags mtshon 'khor/ gsol ka/ bshags pa/ rdzas bskang/ tshogs bsdus/tshogs mchod/ 'gong bkar/ g.yang bsang/ klu bum bsgrub/ klu'i bcos gzhung sogs/ sregs blug byad ma rdul brlag/ smad las/ bzlog pa rtsang/ gshin rje'i mdos/ glud mdos/ klu bdud mdos/ mdos dbang du byed pa/ tshe 'gugs/ gshegs bsdu'i mjug/ gtad sel bcu gsum/ zor dbang bskur/ gtor bskul thun gtor/ chad bstan sog bya'o/ gshin rje'i mdos/ glud mdos/ chamang/ bkyagasa'ajal/ skas khram phyung phyin nas dkar nag dbye bsal gdon thag bcad la bzhag rol bya/ de nas klu bdud mdos/ nad sel/ gzer bdun sogs dang / klu gdon dbye bsal/ klu gdon gshegs/ dug thag bcad/ de nas dregs pa sde bcu'i khram phyung/ dpe sgrogs sogs nas 'byung bzhi'i byad bkrol bcas dgu pa 'i sbyo gdab mjug tu gtor rgyu nyer gcig ltas ngan brgyang bzlog khrus 'byung ba'i byad bkrol gong ltar ro/ de nas byad thag bcad/ sbyin bsreg bya/ glud skor/ glud zhus/ bla bsru nad spo

gong gi gzhan yang / rdzong 'deb gzhi sprugs/ lam bstan/ mdosadabang du bya ba/ bla sgrom bcag la mdos nang du bstabasaso/ klu'i sgo dbye/ dngos grub gdan bskyod/ gshegs gsol/ dkyal 'khor bsdu ba/ thig bsdu bden brjod gter sbas/ zil gnon khyung/ bas /

/gro— yi kho gser skyems gtor ma zag pa med pa 'dod dgus dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa mi zad pa'i gter du gyur/ 'gugs pa'i mgor e ku dza bla tshe srog gsum ling ga 'di la phob rbad dzaphur bskul mgor dgu brdung mtshams rgyags 2 dgu thing / rbad bh+yo thun zor bar bar su sarba ru ṭa ma ra 'ur chem zhib mo bsgral mthar / 000 00 'ur chem mthar ra brdung bya'o/ phrin las raba'abyams thams cad thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par gyur cig/ smad las lang ga ni/ ling ga'i lte bar lce brang steng bkod pa la/ rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i lte bar rloḥtri byad ma a ga ya dza dzaḥ de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyirtsibs rnams la/ mo hā ya nanaḥ stum bha ya nan ga ta ya nanaḥ pra ma ya nan su ru tra nan su sha mi ta nan byad ma me tri nan na po tsa la nan brtsibs mchan rnams laḥ ha rbad tri rbad shag rbadaḥ dza rbad su rbad skru rbad yerbad nan rbad mirol las sngags bkod de rgyab lcags zhags me chu rlung gi ri mo bya de rgyab dza khram dang ཿ sbrul dmar nag gnyis kyis 'khrud mthar zla ba gzas bzung ba ltar kham nag du byas la ling khrus bya'oḥ zhal shes yin nyi li maḥ sa la nan yag tsit+ta mu dra bzlog bh+yoḥ nā ma sha la dzaḥ nā ma'i snyi la dzaḥ nā ma'i mgo la dza byad ma'i sha rgyud snying la mā ra ya dza rbad khrag rgyud rtsa la mā ra ya rbad dbugs rgyud srog la mā ra ya bod rgya pa si ling khro chu khan

phun dzaḥ ho pi ma na byad ma'i bla la rbad rbad sha la rbad rbad tshe la rbad rbad sgog la rbad rbad nus mthu la rbad rbad rigs sngagasal rbad rbad srung ba'i gur la rbad rbad ya maḥ tha duḥrasnyaḥpa sa — phra rgyu dri kaḥni aḥ11 dza gnod byed byad ma'i lus ngag yid gsum stam bha ya nan gnod byed byad ma'i grog rtsa dmar po la mā ra ya rbad rbad zhesagasang ba'i las sngags zhal shes yin/ bcosadakar mdos/ khang bzang chu skyes can/ rgya mdud gong ma sa bdag mtshon byed ser po/ bar ma gtod mtshon lngang/ 'og ma klu mchen byed sngon po dang po mdos shang ngor dru gu dkar dmar srad pa chags pa'i rtsa ris dkar dmar mtshon byed de nas nang nas rgyal rigs dkar4 po rje rigs ser po gnyas drug shar 'dra bram ze dmar 3po 3/ dmangasarig sngon 3 gdol rigs lngang ku de gnyis2'dra/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdzesatshon bya'o/ klu gdon dmar nag gnyisakyisabran rgya phib dmar chen/ khang bzang mar sne shing gi steng 'og gnyisanas bzhog la rtse phra byed nas bran 'khor lo rtsibs drug dmar nag go/ dbus kyi dam rtags rdo rje ser po rtse lnga'o/ mdos mchod ye shesasems dpa' phyag rdor mtshon byed sngon po rdo rje rtse dgu/ steng gi gser 'khor steng du shar du mchod pa'i lha mo bum pa 'dzin pa sngo/ lho ru nor bu 'dzin pa ser/ nub tu pad+ma 'dzin pa dmar / byang du rnga yab 'dzin pa dang me long ljang/ bar mtshon 'khor steng shar du thog 'brug slogs gsum/ lho ru mda' mdung gra 3/

//— nub tu lcags zhags sgrogs gsum byang du tho rdo khra ṭ+wāṃ 2 de rnams bkod 'og nad mtshon dug gi 'khor lo'i steng sbal sgrul sdom sdig bkod/ mo 'khor nor bu mdzes tshon rin chen lnga sbyor ro/ yi ge gser dang dung dkar po dar dathu nga phyogs mdog/ pad+ma dmar ser/ dzos gri lcags thog lcags se rung khab len bzang po'i shing sna'o ༈ rus sbal lto 'khor la/ rus sbal phyi nang gnyis ka ser po/ spar kha' phyag rgya ser po/ 'byung bzhi'i lha mo phyogs mdog/ yi ge rnams dmar ser/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzha/ rtsabs mchan ser po ༈ mo 'khor pad+ma mdzes tshon yi ge gser mdog pad+ma phyogs mdog/ gter bum phyogs mdog lo ya g.ya la bcu gnyis mdzes tshon/pad+ma' lcags zhags dmar ljang sogs kyis mtshon rdzas ni/ a mu dza ti/ sug smel/ ka ko la/ cu gang/ kur gum/ li shi/ dbang lag chu srin sder mo/ ras skud/ dar mthang dmar/ shu dwags dkar po/ chu rtsa/ bu bdun ma pa 'gu yang/ btsan po' thabs sa/ phyug po' klas mal sa dang / g.yang sbu gcan gzan ras/ dar ras/ rgya mtsho'i sbu ba/ rin chen lnga/ dri lnga/ 'bru lnga/ snyang po lnga/ g.yang rdzas chos sman byug go phag nag sna bsgyur 'khor lo la/ phag sngon po rdo rje phyogs mardog yi ge gser/ sna las byad bzlog yi ge mthang ka gzhi gser/ de rgyab yi ge ljang/ de rgyab dmar po/ me dmar po/ rlung sngon po/ chu sngo skya/ sa ser po/ rdo rje sngon po/ gzhi sir po pa tra mdzes tshon/ ༈ me yi

'khor lo dmar ser yi ge gser gzhi mthing/ de rgyab yi ge mthing/ gzhi dmar/ 'dab bzhi phyogasamadog/rnam par rgyalaba'i rgyal mtshan mdzes tshon/ rtsib mchan ser po/ yi ge dmar ser/ de rgyab yi ge lngang ku/ de rgyab yi ge dmaraser/ bdud 'joms zo ba sngon po/ dgra gsod spu gri sngo lnga / me dmar po / dzas na/ rgyal ba bdun pa/ pha lam/ gza' lhum/ klu bdud/ 'dre 'jags/ thang phrom/btsan dug ze ra nag po/ spru nag shu dwag nag po/ tshwa la/ 'bur mo/yungs dkar/ phag spru/ nya byis/ go byi/ tha dkar stag skya ha bo/ a ru nag chu / ar byug/ byi rug pa/ tal dkar nag mu zi ser nag lcags phye/ zangs phye/ gnags chu/ ba gcin/ ldum sbos/ stum rtsa bcas tsha sabar bsags parabya'o/ khyung gi dbus kyi ral byang la 'phyong/ g.yas ral da po la shel/ gnyis pa la sbos shel/ gsum pa la ra gan/ bzhi pa la g.yu/ g.yon rgya ral byang dang po la mu man/ gnyis pa la byu sa gsum pa la dkar khra min bzhi pa lagazi/ ra la thog lcags/ mchu la gri lcags/ ral pa la khram dang se rung/ mig g.yas gser/ mag g.yon zangs/ smin ma ispro shangs lcags zangs 'dres ma/ srog gi rtsa bdun la pha lam/ g.yas kyi gshesags byang brgyad la gcan shazan gyi spu khrag g.yon gyi gshog zur la 'dabs chags kyi spu khrag rdo rje' ra ba ser la sbur len gzhi ljang/ khyung gzungasache bas gzhi dmar yi ge mthing/ khyung rigasakyi spu khrag byug khyung gzungasa'agring ba'i gzhi skags/ yi ge

/sku— gser rdzas gong ltar/ khyu gzungs chung ba'i gzhi dmar ser ya ge spang rdza gong ltar ro/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu po mthing/ hūṃ rnams dmar po/ yi ge rnams gser/ rtsib mchan rnams dmar ser/ yi ge rnams ljang ku'o/ yum rnams skags yin jo/ rtsa ba'i sngagasakyi gzhi gser / yi ge mthing/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi phyogs mdog yi ge gser chab rtsib mchan mthing ka / ya ge g.yu chab/ dzos na khyung lnga dang / rtsib bcur nag po dgu sbyor/ mchan la ser po dgu sbyor/ rdo rje rgya gram lcags len ra phyogs mdog yi ge mthing/ dbus kyi snyang po la/ 'byulnga na lnga snying po lnga dri lnga rin chen lnga/ khyung phag phyig sbrul gyi rdzasasbyor/ mjug sgro la rmig chags/ sder chags 'dabs chags mchog chen gri ru bsad pa' snyang sogs dang sder nag dgu sbyor rnams bsres la byugs go/ rma bya dug 'jomasakyi 'khor lo la/ dbus bzang drug da ser po bya/ rma bya mdzas tshon dang 'khor rtsib lngang/ klu rig phyogs mdog/ rdosamadasabaza' klu bdud sogs drag khros ral rgod byugs/ gzhi rnams sngo lngang mdzes tshon yi ge thams cad ser po bya/ me ri dmar la sgrul lngang nag de la sbal sbrul sha lngags sbyar bar bya'o/ sdig pa' lto 'khor la yi ge rnams mazing ka dang nag po dgu sbyor/ sdig gzugs thams cad la sdig stan dang lcags zangs ral nag dug sna bsre'o/ gshin rje'i mdun gshams ling tshe dgu pa bu'i mdun na rdo dkar dgu 'brang rgyas dmar po 9

khug rkong dmar po 9gtor ma 9/ theb kyu dmar po 9/ bdud gi mdun nas /rno nag 9/ 'brang rgyas nag po 9/ khrag rkong / gtor ma khram shing de rnams nag po dgu re/ de gnyis kyi bar du sha dum dgu spro na gshin rje la skya mi bcu gnyis kyis bskor//kye e ma hoḥ 'phags yul grub brgya'i spyi mes sa ra ha gangs can bod kyi mun sel lang gro ba zab mo gter gyi mdzod 'dzin khyung drag rtsal0 rje btsun bla ma de la gsol ba 'debasaḥ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i nyams myong gisaḥ snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobasaḥ ces nus ldan pa'i gsungs las khol du byung ba'o/
badz+ra: rnga yidag dran kun bzang rol mo dbang chenarta khyung drag po'i dgyes sprin chos kyidabyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ

ga sdo: shin tu rtog dka' blo bral gnyug ma'i gshes so so rang rag rjen pa'i gzigs bya'i yul don dam bla ma rgyal kun 'dus pa'i mdzod lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur dad phyag 'tshal phun tshogs lnga yi sgrub pa lhur len tsheḥkun bzang mchod sgrin rol mo' sgra 'grigs naḥ rgyal ba'i gsu gi bkod pa pho po steḥ khamaX/su/ /sna // rdon dbab ngo mtshar gnas gsang //sna sgo bskul da/ /shā mos gus dang ཿ byin rlaXs 'gyur nges khyed sheX blo gtad bcasaḥ7thog mar rdul gaXnyes skyon sbyang ba ni /(glo e a ā star mo ring ba byas la dro hūṃ 7diniyi 7dhi shā rdo: ༷ rdo: rnyi rdodhi : rdo 'ur mo 'bring tsam byas laḥ dro ༈ :dadro:ṇadirdo zlohūṃdarlisalarādīrjidho ::rto

badz+ra: shādroslo ji rtormi(7 47'ur chem thung phu dihārnyi)skyabasa'agro kur so dal la ring ba'i mthar/ dror byerdor+shaṭ+wātshom glo 7shābadhi /khosgro semag bskyed la byasdu rmi margi bye seshās mad+dhig brnyid 41 zlo yan bdun la/ shaṃ :drani : /lo r+sha mad+dhid rnyi matī 'dro smo martsel la dh+ri rnyi garngo brdo ni ni 'aṭ+wāṃ rlo sgro bka' bgo 'ur rma mthar dror rlo spu rnyid sna ༵ r+sha dro' ci rnyir rnyi dh+rid byum tshung ñca ni 'ar+shas

drol gnin masgo rdo glud bsngo la zlo rnyir 'ardod rdon ༵ /na /rdo dhing ༵ba (ba dī zlo ༵ 17 rdo bgegasabardung ཿ dīr ṅgi rterjisarnyi rnyi lha rte rnyi rnyi rnyi rnyi dho r+sha bam̐ 'ur mo gsum gyi mthar dror zlo hā /gamani~X rdo ṭ+wāṃ' ༷ rnyi gadzhas rmi ༷ dros /nga tshos shā rmi tram̐s rloshā ni dho ṭ+wāṃ sgo srung 'bar la rnyi rdo nyuka /ma dri tram̐ r+sha | ( slo brda sgo dbye phyag la ram̐ 3 dadhi t+t+waṃ brdo rmi 'asnro nyes brtsegs byaḥ rdo byin 'bebs la 'ur mo ring

badz+ra: ba'i mthar ༷ bye rdo rta khyung drag po la tshogs rnams 'ani byordo dbarji bar+sha byirdo phoX cishām dzardomajug tu 'ur rma gsum gyi mtharaḥ berji sbras mace ba:nga rdom tshulas shā /༷ shād ༵ draX dhi darnyis spyir 'aṭ+wāḥ sgo bskyed la 'ur rma mthar chi /rdo rnyir+sha darte chi gams ni ṭ+wāṃ 'ar+shas ji dī zlo rmi zlo brlo ṭ+wā rtoḥrto sgo mdun bskyed de dang 'dra dbang bskur rgyas gdab la ṭ+wā 0:(ṭ+wā rto nishā rdo hārnyi shā dzhardo spyan 'dren

la 'ur // snathar tsho /rdo ṭ+wā sherārnyi rkos rnalto rmi 'arjin gaXgs ni gaXrdoḥ di ༵ 17 snaX 'ur mo gsum gyi mthar bsas gasdol ni dror shā 0: rte rji / studz+wa ṇ+ḍi dī lhardo rdo phyag 4la sdur gro shā ti 0pu 0sdi ོdī rnyi rji rte stasno maza 'bul laḥ dī rji rtodh+ri rnyi garā drochod rnyi ༵tsho rdo ni ༵ ṅgi rli dadh+ris ༵ badzā sbyo sman mchod la ṭ+wā rnyi rto t+t+waṃ rdo ṭ+wā 0dhorto bstod pa 'ur rma drag la myur ba' mthar dror sko r+sha dī la
